title: Evolution of Phenolic Compounds and Antioxidant Capacity of Olive Leaf (Olea europaea L.) Remaining on Branches After Pruning
abstractText: Olive leaves (Olea europaea L.) are an important by-product of olive pruning and oil production and a rich source of phenolic compounds with antioxidant properties. However, their post-pruning biochemical evolution when leaves remain attached to branches is poorly understood. This study evaluated the changes in phenolic composition and antioxidant capacity of Cornicabra olive leaves attached to the branches during five months after pruning under intensive and super-intensive cultivation systems. Phenolic compounds were analyzed by HPLC-DAD and antioxidant capacity was assessed using DPPH and ORAC assays. Oleuropein was the main compound, followed by verbascoside and hydroxytyrosol derivatives. Both phenolic content and antioxidant capacity showed a clear temporal decline after pruning, with maximum values occurring within the first 6–24 days. The super-intensive system consistently showed higher levels than the intensive one. Antioxidant capacity closely followed phenolic behavior, with strong positive correlations, particularly for oleuropein and hydroxytyrosol compounds. Overall, olive leaves maintain high biochemical activity shortly after pruning, and the first 2–3 weeks represent the optimal period for their valorization. These results support improved management strategies and the use of olive leaves as a sustainable source of bioactive compounds.

title: Arterial hypertension, lipid metabolism disorders and atherosclerosis
abstractText: The editorial discusses a wide range of relationships between arterial hypertension, lipid metabolism disorders, and atherosclerosis. The history of the issue and basic data on the epidemiology of these diseases are highlighted in detail. The features of the pathogenesis of atherosclerosis in combination with arterial hypertension are presented. Modern approaches to the choice of biochemical and instrumental methods of examination of patients with a combination of pathology, as well as clinical features, are discussed. The most important part of the article is the discussion about modern approaches to non-drug and drug treatment, taking into account current recommendations.

title: 人工智能赋能青少年音乐创造力的培养机制：内在机理、结构要素与实践路径
abstractText: 教育数字化转型背景下，人工智能为革新音乐教育模式、破解青少年音乐创造力培养困境提供了全新支撑。当前青少年音乐创造力培养存在创意难以具象、培养路径单一、评价缺乏科学依据、作品迭代缺少数据支撑等问题，传统培养模式弊端显著。本文基于创造性认知理论，从内在机理、结构要素、实践路径三方面，系统探究人工智能赋能青少年音乐创造力的培养机制。研究发现，人工智能凭借智能生成辅助、即时反馈、过程记录与可视化呈现等技术优势，重塑青少年音乐创造认知与实践流程，构建“认知卸载—多方案生成—审美比较—循证迭代”的闭环式内在机理，为青少年音乐创造力发展提供底层动力。该培养机制依托创造任务、AI工具、学生创造行为、教师引导与评价反馈五大核心要素，多维度协同耦合形成稳固支撑体系。基于机理与要素逻辑，本文构建任务创设、工具介入、协同推进、循证反思的四维实践路径，打通技术赋能落地壁垒。研究明确人工智能赋能而非替代的核心价值，有效提升音乐创造过程的可见性与可迭代性，完善青少年音乐创造力培养体系，为青少年音乐创造性素养阶梯式发展提供理论参考与实践范式。

title: The prognostic value of interleukin-6 in the assessment of arrhythmia recurrence in patients with hypertension and paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
abstractText: Aim. To study the prognostic value of interleukin-6 (IL-6) in assessing the risk of arrhythmia recurrence in patients with arterial hypertension (AH) and paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (AF). Materials and methods. 95 patients with AH and paroxysmal AF were included in the study. The prospective follow-up of the patients was 6 months, and the end point of the study was a reported recurrence of AF. Depending on the end point of the study, the patients were divided into 2 groups: group 1 included 32 patients who had a recurrence of AF within 6 months; group 2 consisted of 63 patients without recurrence of arrhythmia. Results. The average concentration of IL-6 in blood plasma at the inclusion visit was significantly higher in patients of group 1 than in patients of group 2 (p0.05). There was a significant increase in the Cardio-Ankle Vascular Index (CAVI index) in patients with AF relapses than in patients without AF relapses – 8.9 [8.6; 9.1] and 7.7 [7.5; 8.3] (p0.05). We found a moderate direct correlation between the value of the CAVI index and the plasma concentration of IL-6 (r=0.6; p=0.024). In patients with AH and paroxysmal AF, a statistically significant association with the likelihood of arrhythmia recurrence was shown by such indicators as the level of IL-6 in blood plasma (Odds Ratio 1.42, 95% Confidence Interval – CI 1.18–1.70; p=0.001) and the CAVI index (Odds Ratio 1.31, 95% CI 1.08–1.58; p=0.005). Conclusion. An increase in the level of IL-6 in blood plasma of more than 4.0 pg/ml with a sensitivity of 70% and specificity of 72% indicates a high risk of AF recurrence in patients with AH and paroxysmal AF (Area Under the Curve – AUC 0.76), increases the risk of recurrence of arrhythmia by 1.42 times (95% CI 1.18–1.70; p=0.001).

title: PATTERNS AND MECHANISMS OF VENTRICULOPERITONEAL SHUNT MALFUNCTION ACCORDING TO PROXIMAL VENTRICULAR CATHETER ENTRY POINT IN CHILDREN: A SCOPING REVIEW
abstractText: Introduction: Ventriculoperitoneal shunt (VPS) is the most common cerebrospinal fluid diversion procedure in pediatric hydrocephalus, yet it is the most failure-prone device. The proximal ventricular catheter is the dominant weak point, and the cranial entry point is a determinant entirely under the surgeon's control. This review maps the patterns and mechanisms of VPS malfunction according to proximal catheter entry point in children. Methods: This scoping review followed JBI methodology and PRISMA-ScR reporting. Systematic searches were conducted in PubMed, ClinicalTrials.gov, Semantic Scholar, Elsevier, and Cochrane (2016–2026). Inclusion criteria comprised children <18 years with hydrocephalus undergoing primary or revision VPS, with entry point reported or proximal catheter mechanism studied. Two reviewers independently performed selection and data charting. Risk of bias was assessed using RoB 2, ROBINS-I, and ROBINS-E. Results: Twenty-seven reports (2 RCTs, 25 non-randomized; >12,000 children; ≥379 explanted catheters) were analyzed. Pooled cohort analysis showed an advantage for anterior entry (HR 0.68; 95% CI 0.56–0.83; I²=0%), although the HCRN RCT was non-significant (p=0.062). Proximal obstruction was less frequent with frontal entry (RR 0.16; 95% CI 0.05–0.57). Key mechanisms included ventricular wall and choroid plexus contact (p=0.005), distinct hole-occlusion patterns with parietal entry (p=0.001), and a universal, time-dependent microglia-to-astrocyte transition. Catheter migration was documented only with the frontal route in children <3 years, associated with non-burr-hole valves and right-angle adaptors. Age <6 months was the strongest risk modifier (HR 1.49; 95% CI 1.28–1.73). Image guidance improved accuracy (RR 0.41; 95% CI 0.21–0.78). Discussion: The anterior advantage is modest and time-dependent, mediated primarily by tip environment and proximal obstruction rather than infection. Specific vulnerabilities of the anterior route in neonates and infants include trajectory error and migration, which are technically preventable. Only one quarter of the literature stratifies outcomes by entry site. Conclusion: Proximal catheter entry point is a modifiable determinant of pediatric VPS malfunction. The anterior route is recommended as the default for first-time pediatric VPS, with age-specific risk mitigation through image guidance, cranial inclination control, and burr-hole valve or straight connector anchoring.

title: PENGARUH MODEL PEMBELAJARAN KOOPERATIF TIPE TPS TERHADAP KEMAMPUAN PEMAHAMAN KONSEP MATEMATIS SISWA MTs
abstractText: Kemampuan pemahaman konsep matematis salah satu kompetensi esensial yang harus dimiliki peserta didik karena menjadi dasar dalam mengembangkan kemampuan berpikir logis, dan pemecahan masalah matematika. Namun, proses pembelajaran matematika di MTs masih didominasi oleh pembelajaran konvensional sehingga kemampuan pemahaman konsep siswa belum berkembang secara optimal. Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk menganalisis pengaruh model pembelajaran kooperatif tipe Think Pair Share (TPS) terhadap kemampuan pemahaman konsep matematis siswa MTsS Lam Ujong dengan menggunakan pendekatan kuantitatif dengan metode eksperimen semu melalui desain pretest-posttest control group. Populasi penelitian adalah seluruh siswa kelas VII MTsS Lam Ujong, dan sampel dipilih menggunakan teknik purposive sampling yang terdiri atas satu kelas eksperimen dan satu kelas kontrol. Instrumen penelitian berupa tes kemampuan pemahaman konsep matematis yang telah divalidasi sebelum digunakan. Analisis data dilakukan melalui statistik deskriptif, uji normalitas, uji homogenitas, dan uji hipotesis menggunakan uji-t pihak kanan pada taraf signifikansi α = 0,05. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa rerata kemampuan pemahaman konsep matematis siswa pada kelas eksperimen lebih baik dibandingkan kelas kontrol, yaitu 31,22 dan 27,00. Hasil uji hipotesis menunjukkan bahwa nilai thitung = 2,44 > ttabel = 1,70, maka hipotesis alternatif diterima. Temuan tersebut menunjukkan bahwa tipe TPS memberikan pengaruh positif dan signifikan terhadap kemampuan pemahaman konsep matematis siswa dan mampu menciptakan pembelajaran yang lebih aktif, kolaboratif, dan berpusat pada peserta didik melalui tahapannya, dan menjadi salah satu alternatif pembelajaran matematika di MTs.n matematika di MTs.

title: Conciliación en el delito de robo y principios de voluntariedad y flexibilidad en Ecuador
abstractText: El artículo analizó si la limitación cuantitativa de la conciliación en el delito de robo con fuerza en las cosas afecta los principios de voluntariedad y flexibilidad. Con un enfoque cualitativo y dogmático-jurídico se examinaron la Constitución y los artículos 189 y 663 a 665 del Código Orgánico Integral Penal, y se entrevistó a dos jueces, dos fiscales y un defensor público de Pastaza. Todos admitieron la conciliación en el robo con fuerza en las cosas, pero cuatro la condicionaron a que el monto no exceda treinta salarios básicos, unos 12 750 dólares, y uno sostuvo una lectura alternativa de los requisitos. Se concluye que el umbral impide acuerdos que las partes desean sin que el valor altere la naturaleza patrimonial del conflicto, y que la divergencia interpretativa afecta la seguridad jurídica, por lo que se recomienda una aclaración legislativa.

title: La criminalización del consumo de cannabis en el cantón Pujilí: factores y alternativas desde el enfoque constitucional de salud pública
abstractText: El estudio identificó los factores que favorecen la criminalización de consumidores de cannabis en el cantón Pujilí, Ecuador. Con enfoque cualitativo, se analizaron la Constitución, el Código Orgánico Integral Penal, sus reformas y las resoluciones sobre umbrales, y se entrevistó en 2023 al juez penal y al jefe policial del cantón. Los entrevistados reconocieron que no se distingue sistemáticamente entre consumidor y traficante, que rara vez se determina el contenido de tetrahidrocannabinol y que la cantidad es el criterio decisivo. Se identificaron como factores la escasa aplicación del artículo 364 de la Constitución, la falta de pericias sobre la sustancia, la ausencia de valoración de la intención de comercializar, la falta de evaluación de la situación de consumo y la vulnerabilidad socioeconómica. La evidencia comparada respalda alternativas sanitarias a la criminalización. Se recomiendan pericias obligatorias, indicios objetivos de comercialización y derivación a tratamiento.

title: Generation of Trityl Cation Derivatives from Triarylmethyl Azides for C–F Azidation of o -Hydrosilyl-Substituted Benzotrifluorides
abstractText: Abstract In this study, the equilibrium formation of trityl cations from trityl azide derivatives was examined under various conditions. The generation of trityl cations was promoted by the presence of 1,1,1,3,3,3-hexafluoro-2-propanol, electron-donating substituents on trityl azide derivatives, and Lewis acids. The equilibrium generation of trityl cations allowed the C–F azidation of o-hydrosilyl-substituted benzotrifluorides. Further transformations of the resulting azido and fluorosilyl moieties enabled the facile preparation of a wide variety of fluorine-containing triazoles.

title: Peran Komite Sekolah dalam Meningkatkan Mutu Pendidikan di SMP Negeri Satap 02 Ambalau Kabupaten Buru Selatan
abstractText: Komite sekolah memiliki peran strategis dalam mendukung penyelenggaraan pendidikan yang bermutu melalui kemitraan dengan sekolah, orang tua, dan masyarakat. Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk menganalisis peran komite sekolah dalam meningkatkan mutu pendidikan serta mengidentifikasi faktor-faktor yang mendukung dan menghambat pelaksanaan perannya di SMP Negeri Satap 02 Ambalau, Kabupaten Buru Selatan. Penelitian ini menggunakan pendekatan kualitatif dengan jenis penelitian deskriptif. Data diperoleh melalui observasi, wawancara, dan dokumentasi, kemudian dianalisis menggunakan teknik reduksi data, penyajian data, dan penarikan kesimpulan. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa komite sekolah berperan aktif dalam meningkatkan mutu pendidikan melalui fungsi pengawasan terhadap penyelenggaraan pendidikan, penyusunan dan pelaksanaan program kerja secara berkelanjutan, keterlibatan dalam kegiatan sosial dan pembangunan sekolah, partisipasi dalam berbagai kegiatan sekolah, serta pemberian pertimbangan dalam penguatan pendidikan karakter peserta didik. Faktor-faktor yang mendukung pelaksanaan peran komite sekolah meliputi komitmen pengurus komite, terjalinnya kerja sama yang baik antara komite dan pihak sekolah, serta dukungan dari orang tua dan masyarakat. Sementara itu, faktor-faktor yang menghambat pelaksanaan peran komite sekolah antara lain rendahnya partisipasi sebagian orang tua peserta didik, keterbatasan sumber daya manusia, dan terbatasnya pendanaan dalam mendukung berbagai program sekolah. Penelitian ini mengimplikasikan pentingnya penguatan sinergi antara komite sekolah, sekolah, orang tua, dan masyarakat agar peran komite dapat dioptimalkan dalam mendukung peningkatan mutu pendidikan secara berkelanjutan.

title: Transient-Directing Group-Enabled Manganese-Catalyzed C–H Alkylation
abstractText: Abstract The construction of C–C bonds by manganese-catalyzed C–H activation thus far relies on permanent directing groups that need to be installed and removed, while the use of transient directing groups remains an elusive challenge. In sharp contrast, we herein describe a manganese-catalyzed intramolecular C–H alkylation of indole-3-carboxaldehydes enabled by the use of a transient directing group in catalytic quantities. Our strategy provided access to a wide range of N1/C2-fused polycyclic indoles, generating a tertiary C-center in excellent yields and concomitant good functional group tolerance. The desired polycyclic indole underwent late-stage diversification guided by the native formyl directing group through C4–H activation, as well as leading to the decoration with barbituric acid moiety. Additionally, computational mechanistic insight by DFT provided support for a rate-determining migratory insertion.

Faktor yang berhubungan dengan tingkat kecemasan orang tua terhadap penyakit jantung bawaan pada anak
abstractText: Latar belakang: Penyakit jantung bawaan (PJB) pada anak dapat menimbulkan tekanan emosional bagi orang tua yang berpotensi memicu kecemasan, secara teori beberapa faktor seperti usia, pendidikan, sosial ekonomi, lama diagnosis, dan tingkat pengetahuan dapat mempengaruhi tingkat kecemasan orang tua. Tujuan: Penelitian ini bertujuan mengetahui faktor yang berhubungan dengan tingkat kecemasan orang tua anak dengan PJB di RSUD Dr. (H.C.) Ir. Soekarno Provinsi Kepulauan Bangka Belitung. Metode: Penelitian kuantitatif korelasional dengan desain cross-sectional melibatkan 53 orang tua anak dengan PJB. Data dikumpulkan menggunakan kuesioner demografi dan pengetahuan serta Hamilton Anxiety Rating Scale (HARS). Analisis hubungan menggunakan Fisher’s Exact Test. Hasil: Sebanyak 71,7% responden berusia dewasa dini–madya, 71,7% berpendidikan dasar–menengah, 58,5% berpendapatan tinggi, 67,9% memiliki anak dengan diagnosis baru, dan 79,2% memiliki pengetahuan kurang–cukup. Kecemasan ringan–sedang ditemukan pada 81,1% responden. Terdapat hubungan antara usia (p=0,022), lama diagnosis (p=0,008), dan pengetahuan (p<0,001) dengan tingkat kecemasan. Pendidikan (p=0,706) dan pendapatan (p=1,000) tidak menunjukkan hubungan. Simpulan: Usia, lama diagnosis, dan pengetahuan berhubungan dengan tingkat kecemasan orang tua anak dengan PJB, sedangkan pendidikan dan pendapatan tidak menunjukkan hubungan. Edukasi yang lebih intensif dapat dipertimbangkan untuk meningkatkan pemahaman orang tua.

title: NMR Spectroscopic Evidence for Magnetically Induced Ring Currents in All-Metal-Aromatic [Bi4]4+
abstractText: Abstract Experimental assignment of aromaticity in all-metal systems remains challenging, particularly for heavy-element clusters, where local magnetic effects can obscure signatures of circular electron delocalization. Here, we investigate a supramolecularly stabilized, formally tetracationic [Bi4]4+ ring by combining structurally meaningful reference compounds, solid- and solution-state NMR spectroscopy, SQUID magnetometry, and exact two-component relativistic calculations. Comparison with an isostructural [Li4Br]3+-encapsulated analogue and a binuclear Bi(III) reference compound disentangles global ring-current effects from local heavy-atom deshielding and ligand-specific conformational effects. On this basis, the unusually downfield-shifted 1H and 13C NMR signals observed for the Bi4-containing species provide direct spectroscopic evidence for magnetically induced ring currents in the [Bi4]4+ core. By contrast, bulk magnetic measurements do not reveal significant diamagnetic exaltation, indicating that this quantity is not a resolved descriptor of aromaticity in these systems. Stoichiometric studies further identify chemically competent intermediates that provide mechanistic snapshots of [Bi4]4+ ring formation. Complementary calculations support the assignment of a magnetically responsive, σ-delocalized [Bi4]4+ core, reproduce a rare spectroscopically observed puckering motion of the rhomboidal [Bi4]4+, and underscore the critical role of spin–orbit coupling on electronic structure and dynamics. Overall, this work moves the discussion of aromaticity from predominantly computational assignment toward experimentally benchmarked analysis in the heavy-element and all-metal regime.

title: Organizational Climate of Rizal High School and Leadership Style of its Administrators, S.Y. 2017-2018: Basis for Transformational Leadership Training Program
abstractText: This study determined the organizational climate of Rizal High School and the leadership styles manifested by its administrators during School Year 2017-2018 as a basis for a transformational leadership training program. The thesis characterized the inquiry as a mixed quantitative-qualitative study and operationalized it primarily through a descriptive-correlational survey design. The entire population of 170 Junior High School student-leaders served as respondents. Leadership style was assessed using the 37-item Multifactor Leadership Questionnaire 5X-Short, while school climate was measured using the 42-item Student Development Program-School Climate Survey for High School-Revised Edition. Weighted mean was used to describe leadership styles and school climate; Pearson product-moment correlation and a t-test of the correlation coefficient were used to test relationships. Administrators were perceived to always manifest idealized influence-attributed (M = 3.24) and inspirational motivation (M = 3.26), often manifest idealized influence-behavior, intellectual stimulation, individual consideration, contingent reward, and active management-by-exception, and sometimes exhibit passive management-by-exception and avoidance. Student-leaders described sharing of resources (M = 3.14) and student-teacher relations (M = 3.32) as positive, while order and discipline, school building, student interpersonal relations, and parent involvement were somewhat positive. Significant relationships were reported between transformational leadership and physical climate (r = .98, p < .05), transactional leadership and academic climate (r = 1.00, p < .05), and laissez-faire leadership and social climate (r = 1.00, p < .05). The findings supported the development of a transformational leadership training program for administrators, teachers, and student-leaders to strengthen the school’s physical, social, and academic climate.

title: Two new species of Protohyale Bousfield & Hendrycks, 2002 (Senticaudata: Hyalidae) from the largest South Atlantic coral reef complex, Abrolhos Banks, Brazil
abstractText: Abstract Records of Protohyale macrodactyla (Stebbing, 1899) from Brazilian waters have historically been treated as representing a single widely distributed species. Here, we describe two new species of Protohyale from the Abrolhos Bank, Bahia, Brazil, based on morphological examination of specimens previously identified as P. macrodactyla. Protohyale siriba sp. nov. is characterized by the male gnathopod 2, defined by palm acute with two rows of robust and long setae, palmar corner defined by blunt spine and two short spines, and posterior margin subequal to palm, whereas P. sebastianensis sp. nov. is distinguished by the male gnathopod 2 with basis strongly lobate and propodus massive and ovate, pereopod 7 basis serrate, and epimeral plates 2-3 with the posteroventral corner pointed. Both species differ from P. macrodactyla and other closely related congeners by a combination of characters including adult male gnathopod 2 with palm acute and defined by a palmar corner, and very distinct from posterior margin. Our findings, together with recent descriptions and records from the oceanic islands of Trindade and Saint Peter and Paul Rocks, indicate that Brazilian records previously assigned to P. macrodactyla represent a complex of morphologically distinct species. We also reassess published records from other Brazilian localities, some of which cannot be confidently assigned to P. macrodactyla or to the new species described herein. In addition, Hyale nigra (Haswell, 1879) is reassigned to Protohyale based on morphological evidence. These results reveal previously underestimated species diversity within Protohyale in Brazilian waters and emphasize the need for a comprehensive taxonomic revision of the genus in the region.

title: Electrochemical Ammonia Oxidation Catalyzed by Ruthenium Complexes Bearing 4,4’-Substituted Bipyridine Dicarboxylate Ligands
abstractText: Abstract We have examined electrochemical ammonia oxidation catalyzed by ruthenium complexes bearing 4,4’-substituted 2,2’-bipyridine-6,6’-dicarboxylate (bda) ligands and axial isoquinoline ligands. Bulk electrolysis revealed that a ruthenium complex bearing 4,4’-dimethyl substituted bda ligand showed a slightly higher catalytic activity than that bearing an unsubstituted ligand likely due to the enhanced stability of the complex, whereas a complex bearing 4,4’-bis(trifluoromethyl) substituted bda ligand showed much lower catalytic activity.

Measuring Internet Connection Quality Based on Download Speed, Upload Speed, and Latency Using M-Lab Speed
abstractText: Internet quality is a very important factor to support digital activities such as online learning, for example through zoom. The purpose of this study is to measure the quality of the internet connection based on three parameters: download speed, upload speed, and latency using the M-Lab Speed ​​Test tool using a home network and a cellular network. The stages of this research method consist of Determine Research Object, Prepare Testing Device and Network, Run M-Lab Speed ​​Test, Record, Data Validation and Analysis, Finished. The results of the analysis of the experiment have various variations. Measurements with a home network connection have the highest download speed of 25.79 in the morning. The highest upload speed is during the day with a value of 21.23 Mbps. The lowest latency is also during the day with a value of 29 (ms). For cellular network connections, the highest value is also in the morning with a download speed of 25.05 Mbps, the highest upload speed is also in the morning with a value of 23.16 Mbps. Based on the results of measurements using the MLab Speed ​​Test, it can be concluded that network usage has an impact on the quality of the internet connection. High usage activity at certain times causes a decrease in download and upload speeds.

title: Treatment-Requiring Postoperative Nausea and Vomiting in Ambulatory Oncology Surgery: Four-Year Trends in Antiemetic Utilization
abstractText: Background/Objectives: Postoperative nausea and vomiting (PONV) remains an important complication after ambulatory cancer surgery. This study evaluated four-year trends in treatment-requiring post-anesthesia care unit (PACU) PONV, prophylactic aprepitant utilization, and rescue amisulpride administration. Methods: A retrospective descriptive analysis of monthly perioperative quality-improvement data was conducted from January 2022 through December 2025. The primary outcome was postoperative nausea and/or vomiting requiring antiemetic treatment in the PACU. Because the source data were aggregated, nausea and vomiting could not be analyzed separately, and patient-level risk adjustment was not possible. Results: A total of 15,467 ambulatory cancer surgeries were analyzed. Treatment-requiring PACU PONV occurred in 2041 cases (13.2%) overall and was 20.3% in 2022, 13.3% in 2023, 9.1% in 2024, and 9.9% in 2025. Aprepitant was administered in 6927 cases (44.8%); among aprepitant recipients, 1331 (19.2%) required PACU treatment for PONV. Among 8540 cases without aprepitant, 710 (8.3%) required PACU treatment for PONV. This unadjusted difference should not be interpreted as an estimate of aprepitant effectiveness because treatment allocation was influenced by baseline risk. Rescue amisulpride was administered in 748 cases (4.8%). Conclusions: Treatment-requiring PACU PONV declined over the four-year observation period. Concurrent changes in antiemetic utilization are descriptive and cannot establish that any specific medication or practice change caused the observed decline.

title: La violencia intrafamiliar en la ciudad de Riobamba: consecuencias y eficacia de la respuesta penal
abstractText: El estudio determinó las consecuencias de la violencia intrafamiliar sancionada en el artículo 159 del Código Orgánico Integral Penal en Riobamba, Ecuador, durante 2022, y valoró la eficacia de la respuesta penal. Con enfoque mixto, se analizaron la normativa y sentencias de la unidad judicial especializada, se entrevistó a cinco operadores (cuatro jueces y una psicóloga) y se aplicó un cuestionario a nueve participantes. Los cinco entrevistados coincidieron en que la violencia se puede prevenir, en que influyen factores socioculturales y en que el trabajo comunitario se ejecuta de forma poco rigurosa; cuatro percibieron un aumento de casos y consideraron suficientes las sanciones. Las consecuencias para las víctimas incluyen depresión, baja autoestima e irritabilidad. La principal debilidad no es la magnitud de la pena sino su ejecución. Se recomienda un mecanismo de seguimiento con consecuencias ante el incumplimiento, programas evaluados de intervención con agresores y acompañamiento a las víctimas.

title: Adaptive Reuse Strategies in European Christian Churches
abstractText: In Europe, Christian churches constitute a substantial part of listed heritage. These numerous liturgical spaces are highly significant to the image of cities and possess unquestionable spatial, material, environmental, and symbolic qualities, yet paradoxically society has progressively ceased to use them as religious practice has declined. For decades, a range of strategies have been applied that activate the potential of these underused religious spaces through a wide variety of other activities and uses. The objective of this article is to identify, select, and analyse a series of case studies from the second half of the twentieth century and the first decades of the twenty-first century in which what Richard Sennett defines as “dynamic repair” has been applied: an approach that considers the potential functions of a space with almost no physical modification, completing and correcting what is underused or has fallen into disuse in order to extend its useful life. The study presents a systematic taxonomy of examples of intervention in European sacred heritage within three adaptive reuse strategies—substitution, alternation, and coexistence of functions—which demonstrate how these liturgical spaces can be reused through minimal alterations. These low-impact interventions, combined with the management of uses and occupancy times, enhance the value of this heritage, which bears witness to Europe’s social and cultural identity, and help to keep it active and prevent its underuse, degradation, abandonment or demolition.

abstractText: Kemampuan komunikasi matematis merupakan salah satu kompetensi penting dalam pembelajaran matematika, tetapi kemampuan tersebut masih tergolong rendah karena pembelajaran cenderung berpusat pada guru dan kurang mengaitkan materi dengan pengalaman serta budaya siswa. Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk mengetahui pengaruh pendekatan Culturally Responsive Teaching terhadap kemampuan komunikasi matematis siswa. Penelitian ini menggunakan pendekatan kuantitatif dengan metode quasi-experimental dan desain pretest-posttest control group design. Sampel penelitian terdiri atas satu kelas eksperimen dan satu kelas kontrol yang dipilih menggunakan teknik cluster random sampling. Instrumen penelitian meliputi lembar observasi keterlaksanaan pembelajaran dan tes kemampuan komunikasi matematis. Data dianalisis secara deskriptif dan inferensial melalui uji normalitas, uji homogenitas, dan uji perbedaan rata-rata. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa rata-rata kemampuan komunikasi matematis siswa pada kelas eksperimen lebih tinggi dibandingkan kelas kontrol. Selain itu, seluruh indikator kemampuan komunikasi matematis pada kelas eksperimen mengalami peningkatan setelah pembelajaran. Dengan demikian, pendekatan CRT berpengaruh signifikan terhadap kemampuan komunikasi matematis siswa. Penelitian ini terbatas pada satu sekolah dan materi geometri. Penelitian selanjutnya disarankan menguji pendekatan CRT pada materi, jenjang pendidikan, dan konteks budaya yang berbeda dengan sampel lebih luas.

title: La presunción de inocencia y la autoincriminación ante la negativa del conductor a someterse a la prueba de alcohotest en Quito
abstractText: Se analizó si la presunción del máximo grado de embriaguez ante la negativa al alcohotest (artículo 464, numeral 5, del Código Orgánico Integral Penal) vulnera la presunción de inocencia y la prohibición de autoincriminación. Se analizaron la normativa y la jurisprudencia comparada y se encuestó a 33 operadores de la justicia de tránsito de Quito. El 75,8 % apoyó la presunción, pero el 48,5 % consideró que vulnera la presunción de inocencia, con diferencias marcadas entre abogados, jueces y agentes. La jurisprudencia comparada sostiene que la prueba de aliento no es una declaración y no vulnera por sí misma la prohibición de autoincriminación. En cambio, presumir el nivel más alto de alcohol sin prueba y sin un cauce para desvirtuarlo tensiona la presunción de inocencia. Se recomienda sustituir la presunción por una contravención autónoma de negativa injustificada, con sanción proporcionada y medios alternativos de comprobación.

title: An Improved Workflow for Shale Resource Assessment: Demonstrated Using Triassic Chang 73 Shale
abstractText: Abstract In the context of energy structure transition, fossil fuels will continue to play a crucial role in the near- to medium-term future. Globally widespread shale deposits possess significant resource potential and have become key targets for energy exploration, amid growing challenges posed by the supply-demand imbalance of conventional petroleum and continuously rising energy consumption. Accurate assessment of shale oil potential, vital for informed exploration and decision-making, is still hampered by issues in hydrocarbon loss correction and resource classification criteria. This study addresses these core issues by proposing an innovative evaluation workflow that integrates geological data and optimization algorithms, using lacustrine shale samples from the third submember of the seventh member of the Triassic Yanchang Formation as an illustrative example for method validation. Our findings indicate that hydrocarbon loss significantly impacts the quality assessment of shale reservoirs. As thermal maturity increases, resource boundaries and oil retention threshold gradually decrease. This implies that shale reservoirs with high thermal maturity may demonstrate superior resource quality at similar levels of TOC and oil contents, making them favorable targets for exploration. Compared to existing classification schemes, the proposed method offers two major advantages. First, based on widely available pyrolysis data and incorporating hydrocarbon loss correction, it integrates quantitative characterization of multiple geological attributes, introduces geological boundary constraints, and employs genetic algorithm-driven iterative optimization to establish a rapid, reliable, and practical model for evaluating the resource potential of shale reservoirs. Second, the model systematically considers the influences of organic matter type on hydrocarbon generation, expulsion, retention, and mobility, with enhanced capability in quantitatively distinguishing between retained and movable hydrocarbons, thereby significantly improving its applicability and accuracy in shale reservoir assessment. This research presents an advanced data-driven and optimal-fitting strategy to define critical thresholds for oil content and mobility in shale resource evaluation. The results are expected to provide geoscientists and engineers working on shale resource systems with a robust methodological framework and procedural support.

title: Blended Learning-Based Pancasila Education: Spaces for Practice and Reflection
abstractText: Civic and Pancasila Education tends to emphasize value understanding as a primary learning outcome, while the connection between reflection and value practice in blended learning remains insufficiently explained. This study analyzes students’ reported experiences, reflection, meaning-making, and practice of Pancasila values in blended learning. The study employed reflexive thematic analysis of 871 response units from 67 students at Universitas Pendidikan Indonesia, comprising 47 Elementary School Teacher Education students and 20 Accounting Education students, based on 13 open-ended narrative questions. The analysis identified five categories: learning experiences and self-regulation; social interaction and value practice; value understanding, reflection, and application; contexts and challenges of value practice; and implications for learning design. The findings indicate differentiated pedagogical functions between online and face-to-face spaces. Online spaces primarily supported reflection and self-regulation, whereas face-to-face spaces provided contexts for value practice through interaction, deliberation, and collaboration. Tensions between Pancasila values and social realities also formed part of the experiences that prompted further reflection and meaning-making. These findings are synthesized to explain the relationship between reflective and practical spaces within students’ blended learning experiences.

title: Chemical, Bioactive, and Sensory Properties of Fermented Goat Milk with Umbu-Caja ( Spondias bahiensis ) and an Autochthonous Multistrain Lactic Acid Bacteria Culture
abstractText: Abstract This study aimed to produce and select fermented goat milk (FGM) with umbu-cajá using autochthonous lactic acid bacteria (LAB) cultures and to evaluate the chemical, bioactive, and sensory properties of the selected formulation in comparison with a similar product formulated with a commercial starter culture. Six FGM formulations (FGM1–FGM6) were produced using autochthonous single-strain cultures, whereas FGM7, formulated with a multistrain culture, showed superior performance and was selected for further analysis. During 28 days of refrigerated storage, FGM7 maintained high viable LAB counts, whereas FGM8, formulated with a commercial culture, showed a significant reduction in LAB counts by day 28. FGM7 also exhibited higher antioxidant activity, as assessed by DPPH, ABTS, and FRAP assays, as well as higher levels of phenolic compounds, particularly at day 28. In sensory evaluation, FGM7 showed higher scores for aroma, flavor, global impression, and purchase intention than FGM8, with acceptability indices above 80% for all evaluated attributes; moreover, 73.64% of panelists preferred FGM7, whereas FGM8 showed an acceptability index below 70% for purchase intention. These findings highlight the potential of regional biodiversity, including an autochthonous multistrain LAB culture and a native Caatinga fruit, for the development of innovative dairy products that meet the growing consumer demand for flavorful and potentially health-promoting foods.

title: Leadership under ethical constraint in health, disability and social care
abstractText: Purpose Leadership scholarship often assumes that leadership experience can be made visible through articulation, reflection and representational accounts. In health, disability and social care contexts, these assumptions may fail where naming events, actors or relational dynamics risks harm. This paper aims to examine how fictomorphosis can support ethical sensemaking under such conditions and presents six situated ethical-relational orientations as a reflective heuristic for leadership practice. Design/methodology/approach The paper draws on a post-qualitative, practice-led inquiry grounded in autoethnographic field notes and ethical fictionalisation. Through fictomorphosis, ethically constrained practitioner experiences were distilled into Nuggets and transformed through multiple genre-based retellings. The resulting stories were treated as generative texts rather than factual reconstructions. Recurring ethical and relational possibilities, termed fictomorphs, were identified across the transformed narratives and provisionally grouped into six broader interpretive orientations through reflexive comparison with the stories, field notes and practice. Findings The inquiry generated six interconnected orientations: inclusivity, autonomy, collaboration, transformation, diversity and communication. These orientations are presented not as universal dimensions, validated competencies or a general theory of leadership, but as a situated reflective heuristic. They support leaders in examining how power, silence, care, agency, difference and responsibility interact in ethically constrained situations. The findings also show how leadership practice may be reshaped through restraint, attentiveness, reflexive questioning and the careful calibration of what can and cannot be said. Originality/value The paper’s primary contribution is methodological. It demonstrates how leadership inquiry and ethical sensemaking may proceed when direct disclosure or representation of sensitive experience is neither necessary nor defensible. Its secondary contribution is a practice-facing heuristic that can support reflection, supervision, leadership development and organisational learning in health, disability and social care settings. The paper also extends leadership scholarship by treating ethical constraint, non-disclosure and limits on speakability as constitutive conditions of practice rather than merely obstacles to research.

title: HUBUNGAN KECEMASAN MATEMATIKA DAN SELF-EFFICACY TEHADAP KEMAMPUAN LITERASI MATEMATIKA SISWA
abstractText: Permasalahan terkait kecemasan matematika, self-efficacy, dan kemampuan literasi matematika menjadi dasar dilakukannya penelitian ini. Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk mengetahui hubungan kecemasan matematika dan self-efficacy terhadap kemampuan literasi matematika siswa kelas X SMA Negeri 4 Tanjungpinang. Penelitian menggunakan pendekatan kuantitatif dengan metode korelasional. Sampel penelitian berjumlah 35 siswa yang dipilih menggunakan teknik cluster random sampling. Data dikumpulkan menggunakan angket kecemasan matematika, angket self-efficacy, dan tes kemampuan literasi matematika. Analisis data menggunakan korelasi Spearman Rank dan regresi linear berganda dengan pendekatan bootstrapping sebanyak 5.000 resampling. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan adanya hubungan negatif berkategori rendah antara kecemasan matematika dan kemampuan literasi matematika (r = -0,221; Sig. = 0,202), tetapi tidak signifikan. Self-efficacy memiliki hubungan positif berkategori sangat rendah dengan kemampuan literasi matematika (r = 0,093; Sig. = 0,594), tetapi juga tidak signifikan. Secara simultan, kedua variabel memiliki hubungan rendah dengan kemampuan literasi matematika (R = 0,245; R² = 0,060; Sig. = 0,370), tetapi tidak signifikan. Hasil tersebut diduga berkaitan dengan pengambilan data angket pada masa tenang setelah pembelajaran matematika selesai. Selain itu, kemampuan literasi matematika dapat dipengaruhi faktor lain, seperti pemahaman konsep, kemampuan memahami konteks, dan penalaran matematis.

title: Digital governance capacity and CBDC development: cross-national evidence from harmonized public data
abstractText: Purpose This paper aims to explain cross-national differences in central bank digital currency (CBDC) development by distinguishing broad digital-state capacity from observed digital-payment use. It treats CBDCs as public digital infrastructures and asks whether advancement is associated separately with administrative capability and with the salience of digital-payment use. Design/methodology/approach The study reconstructs a reproducible complete-case dataset of 109 jurisdictions by merging the Bank for International Settlements (BIS) CBDC project database as of 1 March 2024, the World Bank Global Findex 2021 indicators and the United Nations E-Government Development Index (EGDI) 2024. Ordered logit models estimate four CBDC stages. Diagnostics include a Brant-style proportional-odds test, correlation and variance-inflation analysis, a retail-CBDC outcome, an alternative account-reach measure, Firth penalized logit and simulated predicted probabilities. Findings In the preferred model, EGDI is positively associated with higher CBDC project stages, while digital-payment use remains positive but is marginal at the 5% threshold (p = 0.054); high-income status is negatively associated after conditioning on both digital variables. The proportional-odds restriction is not rejected and preferred-model VIFs remain at or below 3.11. The retail-CBDC ordered-logit model yields positive and significant coefficients for both digital variables, whereas digital-payment use remains positive but is not independently significant in the Firth advanced-stage robustness model. The EGDI-by-payment-use interaction is not significant. Originality/value This paper does not claim that cross-national CBDC estimation is new. It extends Auer, Cornelli and Frost by combining their updated public project-stage data with independently published digital-government and payment-use indicators, making all country-level observations and diagnostics visible. Its contribution is a transparent governance-capacity account with explicit nonclaims, temporal boundaries and reproducible country-level measurement.

From Gene-Based Breeding to Haplotype-Based Breeding for Rice (Oryza sativa) Improvement in the Genomics Era
abstractText: Rice (Oryza sativa L.) improvement increasingly uses genome-scale variation, but breeding decisions remain trait-oriented and depend on genetic architecture, recipient background, target environment, and selection resources. This review assesses when phased haplotype information adds value beyond causal-gene markers, single-nucleotide polymorphism assays, phenotypic selection, and genomic prediction. Reported configurations for yield, grain quality, nutrition, biotic resistance, and abiotic-stress adaptation are evaluated according to population structure, carrier frequency, effect uncertainty, haplotype-by-background interaction, haplotype-by-environment interaction, linkage drag, transferability, assay availability, and current breeding use. A three-tier hierarchy classifies configurations as Candidate, Validated, or Breeder-Ready. Most reported favorable haplotypes remain Candidate targets, fewer have controlled genetic validation, and few sequence-defined multi-variant haplotypes have documented use in active breeding programs. Practical deployment requires stable sequence nomenclature, accessible donors, diagnostic assays, elite-background and multi-environment evaluation, cost analysis, and donor-segment recovery. Graph pangenomes, phased long-read assemblies, causal reconstruction, and prospective comparisons with current selection methods can improve future assessment. Haplotype information has greatest value when phase improves a defined breeding decision and increases target-environment performance, annual genetic gain, selection efficiency, or cultivar delivery.

title: Implementation of Conservation through the Use of Native Tree Species for Enrichment Planting in Revegetated Post-Coal Mining Sites
abstractText: The low diversity of vegetation on revegetated post-coal mining sites presents an ecological problem that can restrict forest structure and biodiversity recovery. Native tree species were evaluated for enrichment planting using social, economic, ecological and field-survival criteria in five-year-old revegetation plots with roughly 70%–80% canopy cover. Initially, ten native species were screened and planted in field trials. The revised four-class screening framework classified Anisoptera marginata as High, whereas Aleurites moluccana, Alstonia scholaris, Aquilaria malaccensis, Ficus benjamina, Shorea balangeran, Anthocephalus cadamba, and Syzygium sp. were Moderate, and Combretocarpus rotundatus and Melaleuca cajuputi were Low. Field survival exceeded 50% for A. malaccensis, F. benjamina, A. scholaris, A. marginata, A. moluccana, and A. cadamba. A. marginata was selected as the major recommended species, since it coupled a High preliminary screening class with adequate field survival. The remaining surviving species were kept as conditional candidates, whereas species with reduced survival were interpreted in connection to the studied microsite circumstances and probable silvicultural restrictions. The sensitivity analysis indicated that the restriction of the advice was greater with an increase in the survival criterion. These results highlight the need to use both feasibility screening and field confirmation, rather than just one of them. The recommendations are particular to the partially shaded reclamation settings that were evaluated and require further validation across contrasting microsites and with longer monitoring periods.

title: Motivations, Challenges, Coping Mechanism, Benefits, and Insights of Research Engagement of Mathematics Educators
abstractText: This qualitative study employed Interpretative Phenomenological Analysis (IPA) as its research design and centered on eight mathematics educators from the Negros Island Region in the Philippines. These educators were officially enrolled in master's or doctoral programs at Higher Education Institutions (HEIs) during the academic year 2024-2025. The researcher employed purposive-convenience sampling, selecting readily accessible mathematics educators who also met specific criteria: they had conducted at least one research study, had presented a study, and had taught in a public high school for at least two years. The study sought to understand their lived experiences related to research engagement, using in-depth interviews to capture their motivations, challenges, coping mechanisms, perceived benefits, and insights. The mathematics educators' primary motivator stemmed from a genuine desire to improve their learners' lives, focusing on strategies to enhance comprehension, reduce anxiety, and promote equity. However, these educators faced considerable challenges, including time constraints due to heavy workloads and limited resources, particularly in public schools and part-time positions. To overcome these obstacles, they demonstrated resourcefulness and relied on collaboration, sharing ideas and leveraging networks for support. Despite the hardships, research engagement brought significant rewards, most notably witnessing learners' "lightbulb moments" and experiencing professional growth. Ultimately, the study highlighted the dedication and resilience of these educators, emphasizing the urgent need for institutional support to foster a research culture that empowers them to advance mathematics education in the Philippines.

title: From Recovery To Sustainability: The Mediating Role of Resilience In Post-Disaster Msmes
abstractText: This study aims to analyze a model of post-disaster resilience and sustainability of Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs) based on adaptive capability, risk management, and digital transformation in Langkat Regency. This study employed a quantitative approach using Structural Equation Modeling–Partial Least Squares (SEM-PLS). The research variables consisted of adaptive capability, risk management, digital transformation, MSME resilience, and MSME sustainability. The results showed that adaptive capability, risk management, and digital transformation had positive and significant effects on MSME resilience, with path coefficients of 0.310, 0.280, and 0.340, respectively. MSME resilience also had a positive and significant effect on MSME sustainability, with a path coefficient of 0.390. Furthermore, all three independent variables had direct and significant effects on MSME sustainability. The mediation analysis indicated that MSME resilience partially mediated the relationships between adaptive capability, risk management, digital transformation, and MSME sustainability. The R² value of 0.624 indicates that the model explains 62.4% of the variance in MSME resilience, while the R² value of 0.687 indicates that 68.7% of the variance in MSME sustainability is explained by the model. These findings confirm that strengthening adaptive capability, risk management, and digital transformation through enhanced resilience is important for supporting the sustainability of post-disaster MSMEs in Langkat Regency.

title: Lean tools and Industry 4.0 technologies: a multidimensional analysis of firm performance
abstractText: Purpose This study aims to examine how Lean/Lean Six Sigma (LSS) tools and Industry 4.0 (I4.0) technologies relate to firm performance across multiple dimensions and time horizons. Prior research has focused predominantly on productivity; the authors extend this view to profitability, capital structure, financing conditions and internationalization, distinguishing between short- (2020–2022) and long-term (2012–2022) performance effects. Design/methodology/approach Using survey data from 140 industrial firms in inland Portugal, Lean/LSS and I4.0 constructs were modeled through a parcel-based measurement approach and estimated using Structural Equation Modeling with robust maximum likelihood. Performance indicators were derived from secondary accounting data, expressed as short- and long-term deltas. The structural model incorporates a theoretically grounded performance cascade linking productivity, return on assets, indebtedness, interest rate and internationalization. Findings Lean/LSS and I4.0 technologies exhibit strong complementarity, yet neither shows direct effects on short- or long-term financial performance indicators. Instead, performance evolves through a powerful internal propagation mechanism: productivity improvements drive increases in return on assets, which in turn reduce indebtedness. This cascade is significant in the short term and substantially stronger over the long term, explaining up to 91.5% of long-term return on assets variance and 62% of long-term indebtedness variance. Downstream effects on interest rate and internationalization remain non-significant. Originality/value By combining a multidimensional performance framework with explicit temporal differentiation and a performance to-performance cascade, this study clarifies how operational improvements translate, or fail to translate, into financial outcomes. Results show that the impact of Lean and I4.0 is indirect and unfolds primarily through internal financial propagation rather than direct effects on top-level accounting metrics. This contributes new empirical evidence on the temporal and structural mechanisms linking operational and digital transformation to firm performance and suggests that firms should adopt a long-term perspective, combining Lean and digital transformation initiatives while monitoring performance across multiple dimensions.

title: First metagenomic detection and partial genomic characterization of Bossavirus delphinidgamma1 in captive common bottlenose dolphins in Southeast Asia
abstractText: Background and Aim: Bossavirus delphinidgamma1 is a dolphin-associated gammaherpesvirus for which genomic information from tropical Asian marine mammal populations remains scarce. This study aimed to detect and partially characterize Bossavirus delphinidgamma1 in captive common bottlenose dolphins (Tursiops truncatus) in Indonesia and evaluate an integrated Oxford Nanopore Flongle–Illumina sequencing workflow for viral surveillance using non-invasive, low-biomass samples. Materials and Methods: Fifteen blowhole, anal, and reproductive tract swabs were collected from five clinically healthy captive dolphins between January 2023 and January 2025. RNA and DNA were extracted from individual or pooled samples. RNA underwent sequence-independent single-primer amplification followed by Oxford Nanopore Flongle sequencing, whereas DNA from Dolphin 4 was sequenced using Illumina NovaSeq X. Metagenomic reads were subjected to taxonomic identification, reference mapping, consensus generation, coding sequence annotation, protein similarity analysis, multiple-sequence alignment, and maximum-likelihood phylogenetic analysis. Results: Oxford Nanopore sequencing detected Bossavirus delphinidgamma1 sequences exclusively in the anal swab from Dolphin 4. The run generated 87,070 reads, of which 109 (0.12%) mapped to the viral reference genome, with a mean coverage depth of 0.28×. Subsequent DNA metagenomic sequencing of pooled Dolphin 4 swab extracts confirmed viral genetic material. Combined Oxford Nanopore and Illumina mapping covered 63.7% of the reference genome, with a median depth of 1×; 0.71% of the genome achieved ≥10× coverage. The recovered sequence contained a nearly complete DE1 gene and >50% coverage of several additional coding regions. Twelve predicted coding regions showed 68.9%–97.1% amino acid identity to Bossavirus delphinidgamma1 or a closely related dolphin gammaherpesvirus. Phylogenetic analysis placed the Indonesian sequence with the Sarasota reference strain, with 100% bootstrap support. Conclusion: This study provides the first metagenomic evidence and partial genomic characterization of Bossavirus delphinidgamma1 in captive common bottlenose dolphins in Indonesia and Southeast Asia. The integrated sequencing approach enabled substantial partial-genome recovery from non-invasive samples and supports its application for exploratory marine mammal viral surveillance. Larger longitudinal studies incorporating targeted molecular confirmation, serology, and environmental sampling are warranted. Keywords: Bossavirus delphinidgamma1, bottlenose dolphin, gammaherpesvirus, marine mammal, metagenomic sequencing, non-invasive sampling, Southeast Asia, viral surveillance.

Penerapan fisioterapi dada dalam mengatasi bersihan jalan napas tidak efektif pada anak dengan bronkopneumonia
abstractText: Pendahuluan: Bronkopneumonia pada anak merupakan penyakit pernapasan yang dapat mengganggu kepatenan jalan napas dan meningkatkan produksi sekret. Ketidakefektifan bersihan jalan napas adalah masalah keperawatan yang dapat timbul akibat kondisi ini. Salah satu teknik non-farmakologis yang dapat membantu memperbaiki fungsi pernapasan dan mendukung mobilisasi sekret adalah fisioterapi dada. Tujuan: Menganlisis penerapan fisioterapi dada bagi anak dengan bronkopneumonia yang mengalami masalah ketidakefektifan bersihan jalan napas. Metode: Dua pasien anak dilibatkan dalam pendekatan studi kasus deskriptif. Instrumen yang digunakan meliputi formulir evaluasi keperawatan anak, lembar observasi, oksimeter nadi, dan prosedur operasional standar (POS) untuk fisioterapi dada. Kondisi klinis dibandingkan sebelum dan sesudah intervensi selama periode tiga hari untuk melakukan analisis data deskriptif. Hasil: Kedua pasien menunjukkan perbaikan klinis setelah menjalani fisioterapi dada. Pada Pasien J, saturasi oksigen meningkat dari 92% menjadi 97% (5,43%) dan frekuensi pernapasan menurun dari 46 menjadi 26 napas per menit (43,48%). Saturasi oksigen Pasien M meningkat dari 96% menjadi 98% (2,08%), sedangkan frekuensi pernapasannya turun dari 43 menjadi 28 napas per menit (34,88%). Pada hari ketiga, kedua pasien menunjukkan bersihan jalan napas yang lebih baik dan tidak lagi memerlukan tambahan oksigen. Kesimpulan: Anak dengan bronkopneumonia menunjukkan status pernapasan dan bersihan jalan napas yang lebih baik setelah menjalani fisioterapi dada selama tiga hari. Fisioterapi dada dapat dipertimbangkan sebagai intervensi keperawatan tambahan dalam menangani pasien anak yang mengalami masalah ketidakefektifan bersihan jalan napas.

Enhancing Understanding of Data Presentation Concepts through the Realistic Mathematics Education Approach Assisted by Smart Data Board (PADAPI) Media
abstractText: Understanding of data presentation concepts remains a challenge in mathematics learning at the elementary school level because students experience difficulties in grouping data, determining frequencies, reading tables, and drawing conclusions based on the data presented. This study aims to analyze the improvement of understanding of data presentation concepts and to compare the improvement of conceptual understanding among groups that received instruction using the Realistic Mathematics Education (RME) approach assisted by Smart Data Board (PADAPI) media, the RME approach, and conventional instruction. This study employed a quasi-experimental method with a nonequivalent pretest-posttest control group design. The research subjects consisted of 92 third-grade elementary school students divided into two experimental classes and one control class. Data were collected through pretests and posttests using a conceptual understanding test on data presentation consisting of 20 essay items that had been declared valid and reliable. Data were analyzed using descriptive statistics (mean and N-Gain) and inferential statistics through the Shapiro–Wilk, Levene, Wilcoxon, and Kruskal–Wallis tests. The results showed that the RME group obtained the highest improvement with an average N-Gain score of 0.48 (moderate category), followed by the RME group assisted by PADAPI with an average N-Gain score of 0.41 (moderate category), while the conventional group obtained an average N-Gain score of 0.19 (low category). The Kruskal–Wallis test results indicated significant differences in the improvement of conceptual understanding among the learning groups (p = 0.011). These findings indicate that the Realistic Mathematics Education (RME) approach, both with and without PADAPI media assistance, provides better improvement in conceptual understanding compared to conventional instruction. The results imply that the RME approach can be used as an alternative in mathematics instruction to enhance students' conceptual understanding, while PADAPI media can be utilized as a supporting tool to help students visualize, organize, and present data more concretely.

title: Examen multidimensional del tipo penal de sicariato: una perspectiva criminológica de la delincuencia organizada en la sociedad ecuatoriana
abstractText: El estudio examinó el tipo penal de sicariato desde una perspectiva criminológica vinculada con la delincuencia organizada en el Ecuador. Con enfoque mixto, se analizaron la normativa y la literatura, se entrevistó a operadores jurídicos y se encuestó a 100 abogados y ciudadanos de Guayaquil en 2023. Los entrevistados describieron el sicariato como un problema grave ligado a la disputa territorial del microtráfico, con efectos de temor y debilitamiento del tejido social. En la encuesta, el 100 % estuvo totalmente de acuerdo en que la falta de oportunidades económicas para los jóvenes es un factor clave, y el 90 %, en que la impunidad contribuye a su persistencia. Los hallazgos coinciden con la teoría de la desorganización social y con la evidencia que vincula el sicariato con mercados ilícitos. Se recomienda priorizar la persecución de quienes encargan y financian, el control de armas y la prevención del reclutamiento juvenil.

title: Pengembangan Kompetensi Profesional Guru SMP Sepuluh Nopember Sidoarjo dalam Pemanfaatan Genially sebagai Media Pembelajaran
abstractText: Teachers are required to adapt to technological developments and develop innovative learning media, yet many still rely on limited instructional media. This community service activity aimed to improve the professional competence of teachers at SMP Sepuluh Nopember Sidoarjo in utilizing Genially as an interactive learning media platform. The method consisted of socialization and training involving 27 teachers from various subjects, comprising pretest, intervention (material delivery and hands-on practice), and posttest stages. Data were analyzed using the Shapiro-Wilk normality test (Shapiro & Wilk, 1965) and a one-tailed Wilcoxon Signed Rank Test. Results showed an increase in the average score from 94.07 (pretest) to 99.25 (posttest), with an average N-Gain of 0.85 (high category) based on the formula from Hake (1998). The Wilcoxon test indicated a statistically significant improvement (V=184; p=0.025). Participant satisfaction questionnaire results also showed positive responses across all assessed aspects: Content, Delivery and Mentoring, and Interactive Discussion Sessions. The activity proved effective in improving teachers’ competence in developing technology-based learning media.

title: Small airways disease in bronchial asthma and the role of extrafine inhaled formulations in clinical practice. Resolution of the Expert Council
abstractText: Small airways disease (SAD) in bronchial asthma (BA) has been characterized in detail, yet it is rarely assessed in routine care and is not reflected in current stepwise treatment algorithms. In the ATLANTIS (Assessment of Small Airways Involvement in Asthma) study, signs of SAD were detectable in 91% of patients with BA, and an oscillometry-based composite score predicted asthma control and exacerbation risk independently of forced expiratory volume in 1 second. The aim of publishing the resolution of the Expert Council was to summarize the evidence on the clinical relevance of SAD, to define the diagnostic methods available in Russian health care, and to clarify the place of extrafine inhaled formulations within the treatment algorithm. SAD should be regarded as a treatable trait of asthma and assessed routinely in patients who do not achieve control. Impulse oscillometry with assessment of R5–R20 (resistance at 5 Hz – 20 Hz), area of reactance (AX) and X5 (reactance at 5 Hz) was endorsed as the method of choice; where IOS is unavailable, FEF25–75 may be used provided forced vital capacity is normal. Extrafine inhaled corticosteroids (ICS) are associated with a higher likelihood of achieving control (odds ratio 1.34; 95% confidence interval 1.22–1.46) and a lower exacerbation rate (rate ratio 0.84, 95% confidence interval 0.73–0.97) at a mean prescribed ICS dose 170 μg/day lower. When control is not achieved on ICS/LABA (long-acting β2-agonist) or ICS/LABA/LAMA (long-acting muscarinic antagonist), switching to an extrafine formulation within the same treatment step should be considered before the ICS dose is increased.

title: Pengaruh Fasilitas dan Aksesibilitas Terhadap Kepuasan Penghuni Apartemen Gading Nias di Jakarta
abstractText: Gading Nias Apartment Jakarta is one of the vertical residential complexes that provides various facilities and accessibility to support the needs of its residents. Adequate facilities and easy accessibility are expected to improve resident satisfaction; therefore, it is important to examine the influence of these factors on resident satisfaction. This study aims to analyze the influence of facilities and accessibility on resident satisfaction at Gading Nias Apartment Jakarta, both partially and simultaneously. The research employed a quantitative method. Data were collected through observation, questionnaires, and literature study. The sample consisted of 75 residents of Gading Nias Apartment Jakarta selected using purposive sampling. The data were analyzed using validity tests, reliability tests, classical assumption tests, multiple linear regression analysis, coefficient of determination, t-test, and F-test with the assistance of IBM SPSS Statistics Version 29. The results indicate that both facilities and accessibility have a positive and significant influence on resident satisfaction, both partially and simultaneously. Furthermore, facilities have a greater influence than accessibility in improving resident satisfaction at Gading Nias Apartment Jakarta.

Quark Stars in f (T, Τ ) Gravity: Structure, Stability, and Observational Constraints
abstractText: Abstract Quark stars — hypothetical compact stars made entirely of deconfined quark matter — offer a clean testing ground for gravity beyond general relativity. We study their structure in f(T, Τ ) gravity, a teleparallel theory in which torsion is coupled directly to the trace of the energy--momentum tensor through a single constant coupling. Using the standard MIT bag description of quark matter, we solve the modified stellar structure equations and follow how the mass, radius, compactness, and surface redshift respond as the coupling is varied across its full admissible range. The maximum mass turns out to depend on the coupling in a non-monotonic way: it rises above the general relativity value, peaks near 2.02 solar masses at a moderate positive coupling, and then falls steeply as the coupling approaches a critical value at which the structure equations become singular. The two-solar-mass pulsar constraint is satisfied within a finite window of positive couplings. All configurations on the candidate stable branch satisfy causality and remain below the standard general-relativistic compactness and surface-redshift benchmarks.

Results of the application of intermittent hypoxia-hyperoxia training during the inpatient rehabilitation phase in patients after coronary artery bypass grafting
abstractText: Aim. To evaluate the efficacy and safety of a course of intermittent Hypoxia-Hyperoxia Training (re-oxygenation therapy) during the second inpatient rehabilitation phase in patients with moderately reduced and preserved left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) after coronary artery bypass grafting (CABG). Materials and methods. The study included 32 patients on days 7–10 after CABG. All patients underwent physical training and were randomized into two groups. The intervention group received 10–14 daily sessions of re-oxygenation therapy lasting 40 minutes each in addition to physical training. The control group did not receive re-oxygenation therapy. The following assessments were performed: six-minute walk test, bicycle ergometry with evaluation of exercise tolerance, and LVEF measured by Simpson’s method. Results. At baseline (7–10 days post-CABG), there were no significant differences between the intervention and control groups in the analyzed parameters. After completing the rehabilitation course, the intervention group showed a 21.4% increase in six-minute walk test distance (p=0.02), while the control group showed no significant change (p=0.08); exercise tolerance increased by 50% in the intervention group (p=0.04) and did not change in the control group; LVEF increased by 6.7% in the intervention group (p=0.03) and by 2.2% in the control group (p=0.06). According to the Kansas City Cardiomyopathy Questionnaire (KCCQ), most patients in the intervention group who initially rated their health status as “moderate” shifted to the “high” health status category (p=0.0002), whereas no patients in the control group rated their health as “high.” No adverse events or therapy discontinuations related to re-oxygenation therapy were observed, and vital signs showed no negative changes. Conclusion. Re-oxygenation therapy combined with physical training during the inpatient rehabilitation phase after CABG is safe and significantly improves postoperative outcomes by enhancing exercise tolerance and quality of life.

title: Kelebihan Berat Badan dan Low Back Pain: Tinjauan Literatur Radiologis
abstractText: Low back pain (LBP) and overweight are common health problems that contribute to disability. Obesity may affect the lumbar spine through increased mechanical loading, alterations in sagittal balance, low-grade systemic inflammation, and paraspinal muscle fatty degeneration. This review aims to synthesize the association between overweight or obesity and LBP, particularly based on findings from radiography, magnetic resonance imaging (MRI), and computed tomography (CT). A literature search was conducted using PubMed, ScienceDirect, and Google Scholar for publications from January 2021 to September 2026. Twenty journal articles met the inclusion criteria following screening based on topic relevance, full-text availability, study design, and radiological contributions. The reviewed evidence indicates associations between overweight and intervertebral disc degeneration, reduced disc height, osteophyte formation, Modic changes, facet joint degeneration, spondylolisthesis, spinal stenosis, spinal epidural lipomatosis, and paraspinal muscle myosteatosis. MRI provides the most comprehensive assessment of discs, bone marrow, neural structures, epidural fat, and muscles. Radiography is useful for evaluating alignment and structural changes under weight-bearing conditions, whereas CT excels in depicting bone abnormalities and facet joint changes. However, imaging abnormalities do not always correspond to pain intensity or disability. Modality selection should follow clinical indications, and interpretation should consider anthropometric and functional data. Prospective studies using standardized obesity measures and quantitative imaging are needed to clarify causal and prognostic relationships.

title: Plasmonic Ag@ZIF-8 Monolith for Enhanced Visible-Light Photocatalytic Degradation of Methylene Blue
abstractText: Abstract Water contamination by organic dyes remains a major environmental challenge due to their toxicity, persistence, and resistance to conventional treatment methods. In this study, a plasmonic silver-modified metal–organic framework monolith was successfully synthesized via a sol–gel approach. Incorporation of Ag species during gel formation ensured homogeneous distribution within the ZIF-8 framework, which was followed by in situ chemical reduction to produce a reduced material denoted Ag0@ZIF-8. Comprehensive characterization confirmed the structural integrity of the ZIF-8 framework, with TEM revealing electron-dense silver domains and UV–vis DRS showing enhanced visible-light absorption associated with localized surface plasmon resonance (LSPR). The photocatalytic performance of Ag0@ZIF-8 was evaluated through the degradation of methylene blue under visible light. The catalyst exhibited significantly enhanced activity compared to pristine ZIF-8 and the Ag+@ZIF-8 monolith, achieving a maximum degradation efficiency of 90.4 ± 1.0% under optimized conditions (pH 8, 60 mg of catalyst, 60 min irradiation). Kinetic studies confirmed pseudo-first-order behavior with a rate constant of 0.0358 min–1 (R2 = 0.9923). Scavenger experiments revealed that superoxide radicals (•O2–) played the dominant role in methylene blue degradation, with hydroxyl radicals (•OH) and photogenerated holes (h+) making secondary contributions. The Ag0@ZIF-8 monolith also demonstrated good reusability, retaining over 75% of its initial activity after five cycles. Overall, this work highlights the synergistic interaction between plasmonic silver species and the ZIF-8 monolith, resulting in enhanced visible-light-driven photocatalytic degradation of organic pollutants, offering a promising strategy for wastewater treatment applications.

title: Integrasi Generative AI dan Digital Storytelling dalam Model Pemberdayaan Masyarakat untuk Promosi Desa Wisata: Sebuah Kajian Literatur
abstractText: Digital transformation has driven changes in tourism village promotion strategies through the use of Generative Artificial Intelligence (Generative AI), digital storytelling, and community empowerment. However, previous research has examined these three concepts separately, thus not yet producing an integrated context model. This study aims to formulate a conceptual model integrating generative AI, digital storytelling, and community empowerment as a framework for community empowerment to strengthen the promotion of innovative, competitive, and sustainable tourism villages. The study used a qualitative approach with a literature review method of peer-reviewed articles from the 2020–2026 period obtained from Scopus, Web of Science, ScienceDirect, SpringerLink, Taylor & Francis Online, Emerald Insight, and Google Scholar. Data were analyzed using thematic analysis and conceptual framework development. The results show that Generative AI plays a role as an Enabler Technology in producing creative promotional content, Digital Storytelling strengthens Destination Branding through authentic narratives, while Community Empowerment increases community capacity to manage digital technology. The formulated model concept is supported by AI literacy, digital literacy, rapid engineering capabilities, community creativity, local leadership, digital infrastructure, stakeholder collaboration, and policy support. This model contributes as a theoretical and practical basis for the development of participatory and sustainable technology-based tourism village promotion.

title: New Evidence of MnO x -Mediated Pb Sequestration by Estuarine Biofilms in a Sediment–Water Microcosm
abstractText: Abstract Intertidal biofilms experience recurring Pb exposure due to pollutant accumulation and sediment remobilization, and yet the sources supplying Pb to biofilms and mechanisms governing its uptake remain ambiguous. Using biofilms from Sundarbans as a globally relevant model, we developed a sediment–water microcosm mimicking estuarine conditions and provided a dissolved Pb pulse in a spiked tank, while maintaining an unspiked control for comparison. Laboratory-controlled experiments measuring the Pb isotope and time-series data across growth medium, biofilm, and sediment compartments indicate that biofilm uptake is dominated by the dissolved pool, with Pb removal reaching ∼77% by Day 21. Sediment–water isotope exchange progressively modifies the dissolved-pool isotopic composition, which is subsequently reflected in biofilms through continued uptake. Pb exposure triggers strong extracellular polymeric substance (EPS) upregulation, establishing a reactive extracellular matrix that acts as the primary site where key processes occur and Pb is retained. Biogeochemical evidence further indicates that Pb was sorbed predominantly through mineral-associated pathways within the EPS matrix, including association with newly formed manganese oxide (MnOx) phases and capture in phosphate-bearing solids (pyromorphite), rather than by EPS chelation alone. Overall, this study provides a sediment-inclusive model mimicking estuarine conditions to identify where Pb in biofilms comes from and how biofilms cope with dissolved Pb exposure.

title: COMPUTATIONAL THINKING SISWA DALAM PEMECAHAN MASALAH KONTEKSTUAL BERBASIS KEMARITIMAN
abstractText: Computational thinking merupakan kemampuan yang perlu dikembangkan untuk menyelesaikan masalah di abad ke-21. Penelitian ini bertujuan mendeskripsikan kemampuan computational thinking siswa dalam menyelesaikan soal pemecahan masalah kontekstual berbasis kemaritiman pada materi Sistem Persamaan Linear Tiga Variabel (SPLTV). Penelitian ini menggunakan pendekatan kualitatif dengan jenis penelitian deskriptif. Subjek penelitian berjumlah 26 siswa kelas X.2 SMA yang mengikuti tes computational thinking, kemudian dipilih tiga siswa untuk wawancara yang mewakili kategori tinggi, sedang, dan rendah. Data dikumpulkan melalui tes dan wawancara, sedangkan analisis data meliputi reduksi data, penyajian data, dan penarikan kesimpulan. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa computational thinking siswa didominasi kategori sedang sebesar 57,7%, kategori tinggi sebesar 23,1%, dan kategori rendah sebesar 19,2%. Siswa kategori tinggi mampu memenuhi seluruh indikator, yaitu dekomposisi, abstraksi, pengenalan pola, dan algoritma. Siswa kategori sedang mampu memenuhi dekomposisi, abstraksi, dan pengenalan pola, tetapi belum konsisten pada algoritma. Siswa kategori rendah hanya mampu memenuhi dekomposisi dan abstraksi, sedangkan pengenalan pola dan algoritma belum terpenuhi. Temuan menunjukkan bahwa konteks kemaritiman memberikan pembelajaran bermakna, tetapi belum otomatis mempermudah penyelesaian masalah. Oleh karena itu, pembelajaran matematika berbasis kemaritiman perlu dirancang bertahap untuk mengembangkan setiap indikator computational thinking agar siswa mampu menyelesaikan masalah secara sistematis dan mandiri.
