title: Instructional Skills of Master Teachers, Organizational Commitment, and School Performance in Public Junior High Schools, Division of Bacoor City: Basis for a Capability-Building Program
abstractText: This study assessed the instructional skills of Master Teachers, organizational commitment, and school performance in public junior high schools in the Division of Bacoor City and used the findings as the basis for a capability-building program. A descriptive-comparative-correlational design was employed using a validated researcher-made survey questionnaire and documentary analysis of school performance records. The study involved 878 respondents comprising 11 Education Program Supervisors, 21 school administrators, 50 Master Teachers, and 796 teachers. Percentage, weighted mean, one-way analysis of variance, Tukey-Kramer post-hoc test, Pearson correlation, and regression analysis were used. Master Teachers’ instructional skills were rated highly evident overall (grand mean = 4.50), with classroom management receiving the highest composite mean (4.67) and innovation and research the lowest (4.15). Organizational commitment was rated very committed (grand mean = 4.46), led by affective commitment (4.57). Significant differences were found among respondent groups across all seven instructional-skill domains. School performance showed varying enrollment, school-leaver, retention, and promotion patterns across schools over three school years. Instructional skills were significantly related to organizational commitment (R = .935, F = 9.234, p = .049), but instructional skills and organizational commitment did not significantly predict school performance. Challenges in instructional skills and organizational commitment were moderately encountered, with composite means of 2.65 and 2.40, respectively. The proposed capability-building program was rated highly suitable, highly acceptable, and highly feasible, each with an overall mean of 4.61. The findings support sustained professional development focused on research, innovation, mentoring, instructional leadership, and organizational engagement.

title: Use of Ultralow Dosages of Graphene to Enhance the Microstructural and Mechanical Properties of 3D-Printed Cementitious Mortars
abstractText: Abstract Three-dimensional (3D) concrete printing offers an economical and sustainable option for rapid, formwork-free construction of geometrically unique structures. However, 3D-printed concrete elements often suffer from print-induced anisotropy and reduced mechanical performance. This study investigates the use of two novel graphene derivatives—fractal graphene (FG) and reactive graphene (RG)—as multifunctional nano-modifiers to overcome the aforementioned limitations associated with 3D-printed concrete. The influence of ultralow dosages (0.02% by mass of binder) of FG and RG on early-age heat release in graphene-modified pastes and the porosity and direction-dependent mechanical properties of 3D-printed elements are reported. FG and RG accelerate early hydration kinetics, with RG inducing a more pronounced shift in the acceleration peak due to its functionalized surfaces. Significant reductions in total porosity and critical pore diameter are noticed. Enhancements of up to 25% in compressive and flexural strengths are observed. The anisotropy in compressive strength is shown to be reduced by up to 50% through the use of FG or RG, indicating improved structural homogeneity. The graphene-modified specimens also exhibit enhanced strain capacity and improved crack-bridging behavior. These findings demonstrate the ability of ultralow dosages of FG and RG to simultaneously enhance hydration, refine microstructure, and improve mechanical properties of 3D-printed cementitious materials.

title: Strategi Kepala Madrasah Dalam Meningkatkan Kompetensi Pendidik Untuk Mengimplementasikan Pembelajaran Berbasis Digital di MTs Negeri Ambon
abstractText: Perkembangan teknologi digital telah mengubah hampir seluruh aspek kehidupan manusia, termasuk dunia pendidikan. Fokus dari penelitian ini adalah strategi yang diterapkan kepala madrasah dalam meningkatkan kompetensi yang dimiliki pendidik di MTs Negeri Ambon guna mendukung proses pembelajaran berbasis digital yang telah diterapkan serta tantangan dan peluang yang dimiliki kepala madrasah dalam pelaksanaannya. Penelitian ini menggunakan pendekatan kualitatif dengan jenis penelitian studi kasus. Teknik pengumpulan data yang digunakan berupa wawancara, observasi, dokumentasi serta Teknik keabsahan data yang meliputi reduksi data, penyajian data dan penarikan kesimpulan. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa strategi-strategi yang diterapkan kepala madrasah terdiri dari pengembangan kompetensi melalui workshop intensif, coaching, pemberian motivasi transformasional, pelaksanaan supervise. Dalam praktiknya, terdapat sejumlah tantangan yang dihadapi kepala madrasah, baik secara internal yang berupa ketidakkonsistenan penggunaan media digital, variasi kemampuan peserta didik, dan keterbatasan waktu pendidik dalam menerapkan hasil workshop, maupun secara eksternal seperti pemadaman listrik serta keterbatasan dan instabilitas jaringan internet. Meskipun demikian, terdapat beberapa peluang yang cukup menjanjikan seperti dukungan kebijakan dari Kemeterian Agama, respon positif pendidik, antusiasme peserta didik, infrstruktur yang memadai, dan meluasnya kerja sama dengan pihak eksternal. title: Penerapan Keuangan Sederhana Berbasis Smartphone yang Berdampak pada Efisiensi Pencatatan UMKM Kecamatan Cibungbulang
abstractText: This community service project is formally titled "The Implementation of Simple Smartphone-Based Financial Management and Its Direct Impact on the Recording Efficiency of MSMEs in Cibungbulang District." The primary objective of this public engagement activity is to provide highly practical training and comprehensive knowledge regarding simple bookkeeping methods. Through this initiative, Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs) owners learn to generate simple financial statements and manage their business finances systematically using smartphones as the primary medium. Consequently, financial recording and data processing become significantly more efficient, allowing these tasks to be executed anywhere and at any time. Furthermore, this digital approach ensures that all accounting records are organized much more neatly and maintain a complete data history, enabling business owners and the community to track past transactions easily. The methodology applied in this project consists of field surveys, direct material presentation, interactive simulations, and focus discussions regarding the utilization of smartphone applications. In conclusion, continuous assistance and mentoring will be provided to ensure the effective long-term implementation of simple smartphone-based financial reporting for MSMEs across Cibungbulang District.

Toxicity Evaluation of Microplastics Exposure in Water Contaminated with Pyrene and Methyl Chlorpyrifos Using Daphnia magna
abstractText: Abstract In freshwater environments, microplastics (MPs) have emerged as important organic contaminants vectors. This study investigates the individual and combined toxicity of microparticles of polystyrene (PS) and polylactic acid (PLA) with two contaminants of major concern in Spanish waters─pyrene (PYR) and methyl chlorpyrifos (CPF). Adsorption behavior was assessed using adsorption isotherms fitted to mathematical models such as Henry, Langmuir, Freundlich, and Temkin. PYR adsorption on both polymers followed monolayer behavior (Langmuir model), while CPF adsorption was best described by the Freundlich model, indicating heterogeneous multilayer adsorption. Toxicity of these particles was assessed in Daphnia magna using acute and chronic toxicity assays. Acute toxicity tests showed that coexposure to MPs and contaminants increased immobilization, suggesting that adsorption onto MPs may influence contaminant partitioning and exposure. When organisms were exposed only to the contaminant remaining in the aqueous phase of CPF and PYR (after adsorption), EC50 values increased due to this reduced concentration. Regarding chronic exposure, significant effects were observed on Daphnia survival and reproduction, particularly when PS contained adsorbed contaminants on its surface. Therefore, this study indicates that MPs modify contaminant behavior and provides mechanistic insight relevant for understanding contaminant exposure and hazard processes in aquatic systems.

title: Hubungan peran tenaga kesehatan terhadap perawatan diri: kebersihan gigi pada pasien skizofrenia
abstractText: Pendahuluan: Skizofrenia menyebabkan defisit perawatan diri termasuk kebersihan gigi, yang berdampak pada karies, gingivitis, dan halitosis. Data RSJD dr. Samsi Jacobalis menunjukkan peningkatan pasien skizofrenia 2023-2025 (2.115 pasien). Tujuan: Mengetahui hubungan peran tenaga kesehatan terhadap perawatan diri: kebersihan gigi pasien skizofrenia. Metode: Penelitian ini menggunakan desain kuantitatif cross-sectional dengan sampel 37 responden menggunakan rumus Slovin dan purposive sampling. Instrumen berupa kuesioner peran tenaga kesehatan (7 pertanyaan) dan kebersihan gigi pasien (8 pertanyaan) yang telah diuji validitas dan reliabilitas. Analisis data menggunakan uji Chi-Square (α=0,05). Hasil: Peran tenaga kesehatan kategori baik 40,5%, cukup 37,8%, kurang 21,6%. Kebersihan gigi pasien kategori baik 40,5%, cukup 37,8%, kurang 21,6%. Uji Chi-Square diperoleh p-value=0,000 (p<0,05), menunjukkan hubungan signifikan antara peran tenaga kesehatan dengan kebersihan gigi pasien skizofrenia. Kesimpulan: Terdapat hubungan signifikan peran tenaga kesehatan terhadap perawatan diri: kebersihan gigi pasien skizofrenia, semakin baik peran tenaga kesehatan semakin baik kebersihan gigi pasien. Tenaga kesehatan diharapkan meningkatkan edukasi dan pendampingan kebersihan gigi bagi pasien skizofrenia, serta rumah sakit perlu memfasilitasi program pelatihan perawatan diri secara rutin.

title: Peran Komite Madrasah dalam Meningkatkan Citra Madrasah di MA Bina Karya Melati
abstractText: Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk mendeskripsikan peran komite madrasah serta menganalisis faktor pendukung dan penghambat dalam meningkatkan citra madrasah di Madrasah Aliyah Swasta Melati. Penelitian ini menggunakan pendekatan kualitatif dengan jenis studi kasus. Teknik pengumpulan data dilakukan melalui observasi, wawancara, dan dokumentasi, sedangkan analisis data menggunakan reduksi data, penyajian data, dan penarikan kesimpulan dengan uji keabsahan melalui triangulasi. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa komite madrasah telah menjalankan perannya sebagai pemberi pertimbangan (advisory), pemberi dukungan (supporting), dan pengawas (controlling) dalam mendukung peningkatan citra madrasah, meskipun pelaksanaannya belum optimal. Faktor pendukung meliputi adanya kerja sama antara komite dan pihak madrasah, kesadaran komite terhadap tugas dan fungsinya, serta dukungan moral dan partisipasi sosial masyarakat. Sementara itu, faktor penghambat meliputi keterbatasan waktu dan kesibukan anggota komite, koordinasi yang belum terjadwal secara rutin, serta partisipasi yang masih bersifat situasional. Penelitian ini menyimpulkan bahwa peran komite madrasah memberikan kontribusi terhadap peningkatan citra madrasah, namun masih diperlukan peningkatan koordinasi, komunikasi, dan keterlibatan aktif seluruh anggota komite agar pelaksanaan perannya lebih efektif dan berkelanjutan. The Influence of Rheological Properties on the Adhesiveness of Food Waste and Its Implications for Mechanical Separation
abstractText: Abstract The viscoelastic and adhesive properties of food waste materials are critical factors influencing the efficiency of mechanical separation processes in waste management. This study investigated the moisture-dependent rheological behavior─specifically storage modulus in both shear (G′) and compression (E′) modes, alongside the loss factor (tan δ)─of various food waste types, categorized as solid-like (steamed rice, banana pulp, raw meat) and paste-like (mashed banana, ketchup, mashed steamed rice, yogurt). These properties were correlated with adhesion strength on aluminum and high-density polyethylene (HDPE) surfaces using 90° peel tests. Results identified specific moisture-induced viscoelastic transitions for different materials. Steamed rice demonstrated a sharp increase in tan δ at a critical moisture range, indicative of starch gelatinization. Material-specific correlations revealed that higher tan δ (more viscous behavior) closely corresponds to structural softening and enhanced interfacial adhesion within individual paste-like materials, with consistently stronger adhesion observed on aluminum foil compared to HDPE sheets. However, carbohydrate-rich pastes showed increased adhesion at very low moisture levels. These findings highlight the significant impact of moisture-dependent rheological properties, where tan δ serves as a critical within-material transition indicator for identifying localized risk of clogging, screen blinding, and material agglomeration in processing equipment. The study underscores the importance of considering material-specific viscoelastic behavior and surface interactions in optimizing waste processing technologies and suggests potential benefits of moisture control and material selection in equipment design, as well as the strategic implementation of source separation for problematic waste fractions, particularly those exhibiting high tan δ and high viscoelasticity.

title: Challenges, Coping Mechanisms and Performance of Security Guards at Naga College Foundation, Inc., City of Naga
abstractText: This study determined the challenges encountered, coping mechanisms adopted, and work performance of security guards at Naga College Foundation, Inc., City of Naga, during School Year 2024-2025 and used the findings as the basis for intervention strategies. A descriptive-correlational design was employed with all 33 eligible security guards deployed in the academic campuses of the institution. Data were gathered through a validated researcher-made questionnaire and unstructured interviews; the questionnaire obtained a Cronbach alpha reliability coefficient of .86 and a reported validity coefficient of .93. Weighted means, Pearson product-moment correlation, and coefficients of determination were used for analysis. Results showed that the guards generally experienced moderately low challenges in physical and mental demands, work environment and operations, and job satisfaction and corporation. Coping mechanisms were reported as often practiced in the emotional and social domains and sometimes practiced in the physical domain, while performance was rated very good in personality and personal behavior, work behavior, and productivity. Significant associations were reported between the challenge domains and emotional coping (r = .93, p = .022), while job satisfaction and corporation was significantly associated with personality and personal behavior (r = .98, p = .003), work behavior (r = .91, p = .035), and productivity (r = .92, p = .027). Coefficients of determination further indicated very strong influence on emotional coping and on the three performance dimensions. The study concluded that, although challenges were generally manageable, structured interventions remain important for sustaining guards’ coping capacity and performance. Intervention strategies organized through the Analyze, Design, and Develop components of the modified ADDIE model were therefore proposed for implementation, monitoring, and evaluation.

title: Ataques con sustancias corrosivas y principio de legalidad: calificación jurídica en el Código Orgánico Integral Penal ecuatoriano
abstractText: El artículo analizó la calificación jurídica de los ataques con sustancias corrosivas en Ecuador a la luz del principio de legalidad. Con un enfoque cualitativo, dogmático y comparado se examinaron los tipos de lesiones y de daño permanente a la salud del Código Orgánico Integral Penal, la Ley colombiana 1773 de 2016 y la literatura médica y jurídica. El daño permanente a la salud contiene elementos especiales, el uso de agentes químicos y el daño irreversible, que lo hacen preferente por especialidad frente a las lesiones cuando concurren. Se concluye que calificar como lesiones los ataques que producen daño permanente contraría la legalidad y la interpretación estricta, aunque las lesiones son aplicables cuando el daño no es permanente, y se recomiendan criterios de calificación basados en pericia médico-legal y medidas de prevención y atención a las víctimas.

title: The evolution of treatment strategies for pulmonary arterial hypertension: from monotherapy to combined approaches. A review
abstractText: Pulmonary arterial hypertension (PAH) is a rare precapillary vascular lesion characterized by progressive vasoproliferative remodeling of the microcirculatory bed, increased vascular resistance, and decompensation of the right ventricle. Despite the development of modern approaches to diagnosis and treatment, global and national epidemiological registries indicate a steady increase in the prevalence of the disease, which has an unfavorable prognosis. The fundamental problem in the pathogenesis of PAH is its prolonged latent course: obliteration of the pulmonary arterioles develops gradually, and the appearance of clinical manifestations of the disease correlates with already irreversible structural changes. A natural consequence of the subclinical onset is a diagnostic delay (on average 2–3 years from the onset of the first complaints), which is recognized as an independent predictor of an poor outcome. This review is dedicated to the analysis of the evolution of approaches to the treatment of PAH over the past two decades. The historical era of stepwise monotherapy, which provided purely symptomatic control, has been replaced by the concept of actively influencing three classic pathogenetic signaling pathways: the endothelin pathway (endothelin receptor antagonists), the nitric oxide pathway (type 5 phosphodiesterase inhibitors and soluble guanylate cyclase stimulators), and the prostacyclin cascade. The review systematizes data from modern meta-analyses and randomized clinical trials that convincingly demonstrate the superiority of initial dual and early sequential three-component therapy. Special attention is paid to the analysis of the evidence base for the non-selective oral agonist of IP receptors, selexipag. Based on the results of the landmark phase III GRIPHON study and long-term cohort observations by V. McLaughlin et al. lasting up to 10 years, the high clinical efficacy of including selexipag in combination therapy regimens has been confirmed. It has been proven that timely pharmacological modulation of the prostacyclin pathway ensures long-term control over disease progression, significantly reduces the frequency of hospitalizations, and improves survival. Thus, the prescription of multicomponent therapy in patients with PAH becomes a fundamental standard that modifies the natural course of the disease and significantly improves the prognosis.

Cultural Beliefs and Treatment Adherence with Chronic Kidney Disease Patients: A Leininger-Based Study
abstractText: Chronic Kidney Disease (CKD) requires rigorous, long-term adherence to complex therapeutic regimens, yet non-adherence remains a persistent challenge that threatens patient health outcomes. This study aimed to examine the influence of cultural beliefs on treatment adherence among CKD patients using Madeleine Leininger’s Transcultural Nursing Theory as the conceptual framework. A quantitative, descriptive correlational research design was employed with 74 CKD patients at Saint Mary Kidney Care in Tabuk, Kalinga. Data were gathered through standardized questionnaires focusing on four cultural domains—spirituality/religion, family roles, folk healing, and food beliefs—and analyzed using descriptive and inferential statistics. The findings revealed very high levels of reported treatment adherence and a strong consensus regarding the very high importance of food beliefs and high importance of spirituality/religion in the healing process. Additionally, the study identified that ethnicity, religion, and the duration of dialysis significantly mediate how patients perceive and engage with their treatment plans. Clinical adherence is deeply embedded in the patient’s cultural lifeworld rather than being solely a matter of biomedical compliance. The study recommends that healthcare institutions transition toward a culturally congruent renal care program that prioritizes cultural care preservation, accommodation, and strategic repatterning to foster sustainable, family-centric outcomes.

title: Birch-Type-Reduced Carbazole Anions Enable Redox-Adaptive Super-Reducing Photocatalysis
abstractText: Abstract Photocatalytic activation of inert chemical bonds is constrained by the redox potential of the catalyst. Here, we report a redox-adaptive photocatalytic strategy in which an electron-rich carbazole photocatalyst, CBZ6, functions as a molecular redox transformer through the formation of Birch-type carbazole anions. Under visible light, CBZ6 switches between a neutral state for conventional photoredox reactions and an anionic state for super-reducing catalysis. Excitation of the anionic state generates a super-reducing species with an excited-state oxidation potential of approximately −3.6 V versus SCE, substantially beyond that of the neutral excited state (−2.2 V). This adaptive redox switching enables activation of otherwise inaccessible C–F bonds in aryl fluorides, polyfluoroalkyl compounds, and fluoropolymers. The complementary reactivities of the two states further enable diverse photoredox transformations, establishing redox adaptation as a strategy for expanding the accessible reactivity of organic photocatalysts.

title: KAJIAN LITERATUR TENTANG KARAKTERISTIK KIMIA TANAH DAN PENGELOLAAN HARA PADA PERKEBUNAN KOPI ARABIKA ACEH TENGAH
abstractText: Aceh Tengah merupakan salah satu sentra produksi Kopi Arabika Gayo yang memiliki reputasi internasional karena mutu dan cita rasanya yang khas. Keberhasilan produksi kopi tidak hanya dipengaruhi oleh faktor genetik dan iklim, tetapi juga oleh karakteristik kimia tanah yang menentukan ketersediaan unsur hara bagi tanaman. Artikel ini bertujuan untuk mengkaji dan mensintesis hasil-hasil penelitian mengenai karakteristik kimia tanah serta strategi pengelolaan hara pada perkebunan kopi Arabika di Aceh Tengah. Penelitian menggunakan metode literature review dengan menghimpun berbagai artikel ilmiah, buku, prosiding, dan laporan penelitian yang relevan dari basis data nasional maupun internasional. Hasil kajian menunjukkan bahwa tanah perkebunan kopi di Aceh Tengah umumnya memiliki pH agak masam hingga masam, kandungan bahan organik relatif tinggi, serta status unsur hara makro yang bervariasi sesuai dengan jenis tanah, topografi, dan sistem budidaya. Ketersediaan fosfor masih menjadi salah satu faktor pembatas pada beberapa lokasi akibat fiksasi oleh aluminium dan besi pada tanah masam. Pengelolaan hara yang mengombinasikan pupuk organik dan anorganik secara berimbang, pemanfaatan bahan organik, serta pemupukan berbasis analisis tanah terbukti mampu meningkatkan kesuburan tanah dan efisiensi penggunaan hara. Kajian ini juga mengidentifikasi bahwa penelitian mengenai integrasi karakteristik kimia tanah dengan strategi pengelolaan hara spesifik lokasi masih terbatas. Oleh karena itu, diperlukan pendekatan pengelolaan kesuburan tanah yang berkelanjutan untuk mendukung produktivitas dan mutu Kopi Arabika Gayo di Aceh Tengah

title: “三全”育人背景下新工科专业课课程思政研究——以《材料科学基础》课程为例
abstractText: 专业课课程思政的融入不仅能提升学生的思想觉悟及道德修养，更能让学生明确自己所学专业课程对国家发展、社会进步等方面的重要性以及自身加强专业学习的价值感与责任感，进而以本行业榜样的力量激发自身学习动力，树立为党和国家发展贡献力量的理想，成长为德才兼备的专业人才。通过分析课程思政现存的困难，基于“三全”育人的理念，从专业课课程思政目标、考核与评价模式、思政元素挖掘、教学内容及方法手段与教师队伍思政素养的建设入手进行改革，获得良好的实践效果，为新工科专业课课程思政的研究提供了可行的案例。

title: Fenomenologi pengalaman perawat dalam mematuhi standar operasional prosedur radioterapi
abstractText: Latar Belakang: Kepatuhan perawat terhadap Standar Operasional Prosedur (SOP) dalam pelayanan radioterapi penting untuk menjamin keselamatan pasien. Risiko khusus dalam radioterapi menuntut ketepatan, konsistensi, komunikasi yang efektif, dan pengambilan keputusan klinis yang tepat. Eksplorasi pengalaman perawat diperlukan untuk memahami bagaimana kepatuhan terhadap SOP terbentuk dan dipertahankan dalam praktik klinis. Tujuan: mengeksplorasi pengalaman perawat dalam mematuhi SOP radioterapi di RSUD Dr. (H.C.) Ir. Soekarno Provinsi Kepulauan Bangka Belitung, termasuk faktor-faktor yang memengaruhi kepatuhan serta pemaknaan kepatuhan terhadap SOP dalam menjaga keselamatan pasien. Metode: desain kualitatif dengan pendekatan fenomenologi. Enam perawat dari Unit Radioterapi dipilih melalui teknik purposive sampling. Data dikumpulkan melalui wawancara mendalam dan dianalisis menggunakan metode fenomenologi Colaizzi. Hasil: Ditemukan tujuh tema esensial, yaitu: (1) adaptasi di Unit Radioterapi membentuk kepatuhan terhadap SOP; (2) SOP menjadi pedoman dalam menjaga keselamatan pasien; (3) asesmen klinis mengarahkan pengambilan keputusan; (4) pengalaman near miss menjadi sumber pembelajaran profesional; (5) komunikasi dan kolaborasi tim mendukung penerapan SOP; (6) budaya keselamatan pasien memperkuat kepatuhan; dan (7) refleksi profesional membentuk identitas profesional perawat. Temuan menunjukkan bahwa kepatuhan terhadap SOP tidak terbatas pada mengikuti prosedur yang telah ditetapkan, tetapi juga dibentuk oleh pengalaman klinis, proses pembelajaran, kerja sama tim, budaya keselamatan, dan refleksi profesional. Kesimpulan: Kepatuhan perawat terhadap SOP radioterapi berkembang melalui proses adaptasi, asesmen klinis, pembelajaran dari pengalaman, komunikasi, kolaborasi, dan budaya keselamatan pasien yang mendukung. Kepatuhan tidak hanya dimaknai sebagai kewajiban institusional, tetapi juga sebagai bentuk tanggung jawab profesional dan komitmen perawat terhadap keselamatan pasien. Unit radioterapi perlu memperkuat kepatuhan terhadap SOP melalui pelatihan berkelanjutan, evaluasi kompetensi secara berkala, penguatan komunikasi tim, dan pembangunan budaya keselamatan pasien. Pelaporan near miss dan praktik reflektif juga perlu didorong sebagai sarana pembelajaran untuk meningkatkan kualitas praktik klinis dan keselamatan pasien.

title: Environmental Pollution in Food Production and Pathways for Mitigation through Sustainable and Circular Approaches
abstractText: Abstract Global food production is under increasing pressure to meet global food security demands while simultaneously reducing environmental burdens. This review critically evaluates air emissions, greenhouse gas (GHG) contributions, water pollution, and solid waste generation across the entire food production life cycle, including agricultural production, food processing, and associated waste management. Over its entire life cycle, global food production contributes approximately 58% of anthropogenic PM 2.5 emissions, and 72% ammonia ( NH 3 ), underscoring its substantial impact on air quality. In addition, irrigation activities alone contribute nearly 70% of global freshwater withdrawals, while the food manufacturing sector accounts for about 30% of total industrial water consumption, highlighting the sector’s intensive water demand. Food loss and waste (FLW) further exacerbate environmental burdens, with landfill disposal responsible for an estimated 58% of fugitive methane emissions from municipal landfills due to food waste decomposition. This review synthesizes mitigation strategies including resource recovery (nutrient, energy, material), low-energy approaches, zero liquid discharge (ZLD), sustainable agricultural practices, and advancements in food processing technologies. By integrating environmental performance, technology readiness level (TRL), and implementation barriers, this review advances beyond existing studies that focus on isolated processes and identifying key bottlenecks and research gaps; the study provides practical insights to support the development of environmentally responsible and resource-efficient food production.

title: Pengembangan dan Implementasi Antar Muka Website Perusahaan sebagai Media Informasi pada PT PDPDE Hilir
abstractText: Communicating information through a corporate website requires coherence among its information structure, navigation, visual presentation, and corporate identity. This study aimed to describe the development and implementation of the PT PDPDE Hilir website interface as a medium for corporate information. The study employed a descriptive qualitative approach. Data were collected through direct observation of the existing website, documentation of pages and interface structure, and discussions with the field supervisor and relevant parties. The development process included identifying information and interface requirements, designing a prototype using Figma, and implementing the design using HTML and CSS through Visual Studio Code. The development results showed the organization of the navigation structure, corporate information, content grouping, page layout, and interface appearance. The website structure comprises the main sections Home, About Us, Services, Media & Information, and Contact, along with the Latest News and Activity Gallery submenus, which were implemented as separate pages. This development integrated information organization, interface design, and technical implementation to produce a more structured medium for corporate information while preserving PT PDPDE Hilir’s visual identity. The practical contribution of this study is an account of the interface development process that can serve as a reference for developing websites for similar companies.

title: PEMANFAATAN LABORATORIUM ALAM SEBAGAI MEDIA PEMBELAJARAN EKOSISTEM UNTUK MENINGKATKAN SIKAP ILMIAH SISWA
abstractText: Pembelajaran biologi pada materi ekosistem belum sepenuhnya mengoptimalkan keterlibatan siswa secara langsung sehingga sikap ilmiah seperti rasa ingin tahu, berpikir kritis, dan objektivitas perlu didukung melalui pemanfaatan lingkungan sebagai sumber belajar. Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk mengetahui pemanfaatan laboratorium alam sebagai media pembelajaran pada materi ekosistem dalam meningkatkan sikap ilmiah siswa. Penelitian ini menggunakan pendekatan kuantitatif dengan jenis pra-eksperimental dan desain One Group Pretest-Posttest. Populasi penelitian berjumlah 122 siswa kelas X MAS Oemar Diyan dengan sampel sebanyak 32 siswa kelas X-1, yang mengikuti pembelajaran di ruang kelas dan pembelajaran dengan memanfaatkan laboratorium alam. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan nilai rata-rata LKPD sebesar 57 pada pembelajaran di ruang kelas dan 85 setelah pembelajaran dengan memanfaatkan laboratorium alam. Nilai N-Gain sebesar 0,65 menunjukkan peningkatan dalam kategori sedang, sedangkan hasil observasi menunjukkan sikap ilmiah siswa lebih sering dan selalu muncul selama pembelajaran di laboratorium alam, terutama pada aspek rasa ingin tahu, berpikir kritis, dan objektivitas. Pemanfaatan laboratorium alam dapat menjadi alternatif media pembelajaran pada materi ekosistem untuk mendukung perkembangan sikap ilmiah siswa.

title: Structural Evolution and Chemical Incorporation Pathways in Wadsley-Roth Oxides
abstractText: Abstract We investigate solid-state reaction pathways to high-temperature phase formation in the entropy-stabilized Wadsley-Roth Ti(NbxTa1–x)2O7 phases. We analyze and discuss thermodynamic and kinetic factors governing these processes in TiNb2O7, TiTa2O7, and Ti(NbTa)2O7. Diffraction-centric experiments enable in situ phase formation studies throughout the intermediate temperature regime (600–1200 °C). We also differentiate between solid-state reaction pathways across the compositional family using both qualitative and quantitative approaches. We identify phase evolution between related Wadsley-Roth phases with different cation sublattice decorations and shear block dimensions. We observe minimum stabilization temperatures consistent with prior predictions for cation sublattice mixing, suggesting some entropic contribution to thermodynamic phase stabilization. Composition-dependent differences in reaction pathways highlight opportunities for targeting specific intermediate phases by adjusting the chemical ensemble, with possible implications for functional and extreme materials.

Constructing an Adaptive Learning Framework Integrating STEAM–Gamification for Numeracy and Computational Thinking in Remote Indonesian Elementary Schools
abstractText: This study aimed to construct and validate the design of an adaptive learning framework that integrates STEAM–gamification principles with Zone of Proximal Development (ZPD)–Item Response Theory (IRT) to simultaneously develop numeracy literacy and computational thinking among elementary school students in Indonesia’s 3T (remote, frontier, underdeveloped) regions. A mixed-methods sequential exploratory design integrated with Design-Based Research (DBR) was applied over eight months in Pinrang Regency, South Sulawesi, across 10 schools in the qualitative phase and 20 schools in the quantitative phase. Qualitative data were drawn from interviews and focus group discussions with 30 teachers, 10 principals, 30 students, and 20 stakeholders, alongside 30 classroom observations; quantitative data were collected from 300 Grade IV–V students and 60 teachers using structured surveys, IRT-calibrated diagnostic tests (3PL; α = .83), and an ICT infrastructure audit. The framework synthesized qualitative and quantitative findings into four integrated layers: Pedagogical (STEAM), Motivational (gamification), Adaptive (ZPD–IRT), and Assessment (computational thinking + numeracy). Expert design validation employed LORI, Aiken’s V, and Fleiss’ Kappa with eight domain specialists. The needs analysis showed that 85% of teachers relied exclusively on conventional instruction, 78% identified a strong need for interactive learning media, and only 30% of schools had adequate ICT infrastructure. The composite numeracy mean was 50.1/100 and the computational thinking mean was 48.3/100, with geometry the weakest numeracy domain (34.7). Economic feasibility yielded a benefit-cost ratio of 1.42, a positive NPV, and an internal rate of return of 18.3%. Expert design validation yielded a LORI mean of 4.38/5, a Fleiss’ Kappa of 0.74, and an Aiken’s V of 0.79, all exceeding acceptability thresholds. The four-layer adaptive framework, among the first to integrate STEAM, gamification, ZPD–IRT adaptive learning, and computational thinking as a coherent system for Indonesia’s 3T elementary schools, provides a replicable theoretical model and an expert-validated design basis for subsequent product development and efficacy trials Keywords: adaptive learning framework, STEAM–gamification, numeracy literacy, computational thinking, 3T elementary schools.

title: Quality of cookies supplemented with various levels of chrysanthemum tea residue powder
abstractText: In the context of promoting circular economy and zero waste strategies in the food industry, valorization of food by-products into new food ingredients is a promising approach to enhance sustainable development. Chrysanthemum (Chrysanthemum indicum L.) tea residue (CTR), a by-product that is often discarded after extraction, contained high levels of dietary fiber and phenolic compounds. This study investigated the potential use of CTR powder as a functional ingredient in the production of cookies by partially replacing wheat flour at levels of 0, 2.5, 5, 7.5 and 10%. Chemical composition, antioxidant capacity, instrumental color, textural and sensory properties of the fortified cookie samples were determined and compared. CTR powder exhibited significantly higher protein, lipid, ash, dietary fiber and phenolic contents than wheat flour. The antioxidant capacities of CTR powder measured by DPPH and FRAP assays were 46.5 and 48.1 times higher, respectively, than those of wheat flour. Cookies supplemented with CTR showed a marked enhancement in dietary fiber and antioxidant contents. At a 10% replacement level, the antioxidant capacities of cookies evaluated by DPPH and FRAP assays increased by 4.9 and 3.1 times, respectively, compared to those of the control. However, high CTR levels also resulted in dark color, firm texture, and decreased flavor and aroma scores. Cookies supplemented with 7.5% CTR powder had high dietary fiber content and antioxidant activity with an acceptable sensory score. These findings suggest that CTR powder is a promising ingredient for partial replacement of wheat flour in the making of dietary fiber - and antioxidant - enriched cookies.

title: PERFIL EPIDEMIOLÓGICO DA TOXOPLASMOSE GESTACIONAL NO ACRE, AMAZÔNIA OCIDENTAL, 2020–2025
abstractText: Objetivo: Descrever o perfil epidemiológico dos casos de toxoplasmose gestacional notificados no Acre, Amazônia Ocidental, entre 2020 e 2025. Métodos: estudo epidemiológico descritivo, retrospectivo, de abordagem quantitativa, realizado com dados secundários do Sistema de Informação de Agravos de Notificação, disponibilizados pelo Departamento de Informática do Sistema Único de Saúde. Foram analisadas as variáveis ano de notificação, faixa etária, raça/cor, escolaridade, idade gestacional, critério diagnóstico e evolução, por meio de frequências absolutas e relativas. Resultados: foram registrados 1.778 casos de toxoplasmose gestacional no período analisado, com maior número de notificações em 2025 (n=835). Predominaram gestantes de 20 a 39 anos (74,0%), de raça/cor parda (81,4%) e com ensino médio (37,0%), seguido do ensino fundamental (33,8%). Quanto às características clínicas, 37,9% dos casos foram diagnosticados no segundo trimestre gestacional e 89,8% tiveram confirmação laboratorial. Em relação à evolução, 48,6% foram registrados como cura, enquanto 51,3% apresentaram evolução ignorada ou em branco. Conclusão: Os achados evidenciam desafios para a vigilância e o acompanhamento da toxoplasmose gestacional no Acre, especialmente quanto à completude das informações sobre a evolução dos casos. O fortalecimento da qualidade dos registros, aliado ao diagnóstico oportuno e ao acompanhamento adequado no pré-natal, é fundamental para qualificar a vigilância do agravo e subsidiar estratégias de prevenção da transmissão vertical e de proteção à saúde materno-infantil.

title: O'ZBEKISTONDA SPELEOTURIZM OBYEKTLARINI BOSHQARISH MODELI

title: Dietary transformation and health vulnerability following lake poopó degradation: a cross sectional study in the indigenous Uru Vilañeque Community
abstractText: Objective: To evaluate the association of occupational transformation, dietary transformation, and current environmental exposure with family health vulnerability in the Indigenous Uru Vilañeque community following the degradation of Lake Poopó, Bolivia. Methodology: A quantitative, observational, retrospective, and cross-sectional study was conducted using a census of 32 families. A 40-item structured survey was used to comparatively reconstruct previous and current conditions related to occupation, food consumption, household materials, diseases, and symptoms. Normalized indices of occupational transformation, dietary transformation, environmental transformation, current environmental risk, and health vulnerability were constructed. The analysis included descriptive statistics, Pearson correlations, ordinary least squares regression, Beta regression, and diagnostic tests. Results: Mean dietary transformation was 0.744, current environmental risk was 0.890, and global health vulnerability was 0.740. Dietary transformation showed the most consistent bivariate association with symptomatic vulnerability (r=0.440; p=0.012). In the reduced Beta regression re-estimated with 31 observations, dietary transformation remained positively and statistically significantly associated with symptomatic vulnerability (β=3.432; p=0.007), whereas the current environmental indicator was not significant (p=0.213). Comparison of Beta specifications on 29 complete cases favored the reduced model according to AIC and BIC. Conclusion: Among the families studied, dietary transformation was the socio-ecological dimension most closely associated with symptomatic vulnerability. The findings support integrating food systems, health, and socio-ecological adaptation when analyzing Indigenous communities affected by ecosystem degradation, while avoiding causal interpretations from a cross-sectional design.

title: The origins of the Siberian therapeutic school. On the 130th Anniversary of Academician D.D. Yablokov (1896–1993)
abstractText: The article describes the origins of the Siberian Therapeutic School. title: Strategi Pengelolaan Perilaku Peserta Didik Dalam Mengaatasi Bullying Verbal Terhadap Tenaga Pendidik di SMP Negeri 10 Huamual Kabupaten Seram Bagian Barat
abstractText: Perilaku bullying verbal peserta didik terhadap tenaga pendidik memiliki dampak yang dapat menyebabkan menurunnya etika peserta didik dan terganggunya proses pembelajaran, sehingga diperlukan strategi penanganan yang tepat. Tujuan penelitian ini untuk mengetahui bentuk-bentuk bullying verbal serta menganalisis strategi pengelolaan perilaku peserta didik dalam mengatasinya. Pendekatan kualitatif dengan jenis Studi Kasus penelitian ini dilakukan di Smp Negeri 10 Humual. Teknik pengumpulan data meliputi observasi, wawancara, dan dokumentasi, sedangkan analisis data dilakukan melalui reduksi, penyajian, dan penarikan kesimpulan dan uji keabsahan triangulasi data. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa bullying verbal yang terjadi di SMP Negeri 10 Huamual berupa penggunaan kata perinta terhadap tenaga pendidik, mengomentari cara mengajar tenaga pendidik, sikap cuek dan pemberian julukan terhadap tenaga pendidik. serta strategi yang diterapkan meliputi pendekatan preventif, kuratif, dan kolaboratif dimana strategi ini mampu menciptakan lingkungan belajar yang lebih kondusif. Kesimpulan penelitian ini menunjukkan bahwa bullying verbal terhadap tenaga pendidik di SMP Negeri 10 Huamual masih terjadi dalam berbagai bentuk. Untuk mengatasinya, sekolah menerapkan strategi preventif, kuratif, dan kolaboratif yang mampu menciptakan lingkungan belajar yang lebih kondusif. Disarankan agar pihak sekolah memasang papan tatatertib dan poster bullying dan kerja sama dengan pihak Bk pada sekolah lain. title: Beyond Survival: Rural Youth Perspectives on the Developmental Impact and Limitations of South Africa’s COVID-19 Social Relief of Distress Grant
abstractText: South Africa’s Social Relief of Distress (SRD) grant provides an income floor to unemployed working-age adults who remain outside most categorical social grants. This article examines how 11 unemployed recipients aged 21–34 in Steenbokpan Village, Limpopo Province, experienced and used the grant and whether it opened pathways beyond immediate survival. An interpretivist, phenomenological design was used. English-language, face-to-face, semi-structured interviews were audio-recorded, transcribed, and manually analyzed using inductive thematic analysis. The SRD was used mainly for food, household essentials, transport, and communication; these expenditures reduced acute hardship and enabled modest household contributions. Some participants engaged in informal trade or used the grant for job-search costs, but subsistence pressures, the low transfer value, transport-to-town costs, weak connectivity, and a thin local labor market prevented these efforts from becoming durable livelihood pathways. Participants preferred practical training linked to actual work, enterprise mentoring, and accessible employment support to indefinite reliance on relief. The article’s contribution is not the unsurprising observation that a small transfer is spent on basic needs. Rather, it shows the rural mechanism by which an income floor fails to serve as a ladder; the same limited payment must cover food, mobility, digital access, and livelihood costs in a place with few nearby opportunities. Guided primarily by social development theory and complemented by Sen’s capability perspective, the study concludes that the SRD grant is protective and dignity-supporting but developmentally incomplete.

Predictors of gastrointestinal bleeding in patients with coronary artery disease: results of a single-center study
abstractText: Aim. To identify clinical and laboratory predictors of gastrointestinal bleeding in patients with coronary artery disease (CAD) receiving antiplatelet therapy. Materials and methods. A single-center cohort study was conducted, including 161 patients with CAD receiving antiplatelet therapy. The study group consisted of 55 patients with gastrointestinal bleeding (GIB), and the control group included 106 patients without GIB during the entire follow-up period. Demographic data, risk factors (smoking, diabetes mellitus, arterial hypertension), laboratory parameters [hemoglobin, creatinine, eGFR (by CKD-EPI formula), glucose, H. pylori status], and therapy data were collected retrospectively. Prospective follow-up (for 6 months) assessed erosive and ulcerative changes by esophagogastroduodenoscopy and the occurrence of GIB. Independent predictors were identified using multivariable logistic regression analysis. Results. The study included 161 patients with an established diagnosis of CAD receiving antiplatelet therapy. GIB was recorded in 55 (34.2%) patients. According to multivariable logistic regression analysis, independent predictors of GIB were: a history of duodenal ulcer (OR 6.57; p=0.005), smoking (OR 3.70; p=0.001), presence of pulmonary hypertension (OR 3.59; p=0.002), H. pylori infection (OR 3.41; p0.001), as well as elevated glucose levels (OR 1.28 per 1 mmol/L; p0.001) and creatinine levels (OR 1.02 per 1 μmol/L; p0.001). Conclusion. The identified predictors of GIB, including gastroenterological (duodenal ulcer history, H. pylori infection), behavioral factors (smoking), and comorbid conditions (hyperglycemia, elevated creatinine levels), can be used for risk stratification and timely effective prevention of GIB in patients with CAD receiving antiplatelet therapy.
